cast.roleZh: 少年勇者 · 魔法學徒

cast.noteZh: 十一歲的沉穩小程式員，因為停下來幫助同學而穿越翠綠螢幕漩渦。身穿橄欖綠披風、慈濟蓮花腰帶扣，帶著古咒書、熔合鐵劍與矮人鋼甲。

cast.debutZh: 第三章相遇 · 第五章取名
cast.noteEn: A scruffy golden-tan puppy who meets Kai at Grandma Looma's cottage, earns the name String through input(), and gains a glowing telepathic str ribbon bond.
cast.noteZh: 毛茸茸的金黃色小狗，在魯瑪奶奶的木屋遇見凱，透過 Listen 咒語獲得「String」這個名字，並在水晶洞獲得心電感應的文字絲帶。

cast.noteEn: Welcomes Kai into Pythonia with his glowing blue-crystal staff, gifts the silver Spatial Dimensional Pocket pouch, and leaves Kai to walk bravely on his own.
cast.noteZh: 手持閃耀藍水晶魔杖迎接凱，教導基礎魔法並贈予銀色空間百寶袋，最後在銀葉樹下化為翠綠星光，讓凱學會獨立思考。

cast.noteEn: Sits warmly at her giant oak loom surrounded by rainbow ribbons, teaching Kai how the Comma Weave (,) gives words comfortable breathing room.
cast.noteZh: 在掛滿彩虹絲帶的木屋裡操作巨大的橡木織布機，溫柔地教導凱用逗號「,」把單字編織成流暢又暖心的句子。

cast.noteEn: Stout horned-helmet smith with a triple-braided silver beard who shows Kai how the Plus sign (+) melts two broken halves into one solid IronSword.
cast.noteZh: 戴著雙角鐵盔、留著三股銀白辮子鬍的壯碩鐵匠，在火花四濺的鐵砧前教凱用加號「+」無縫熔合斷裂的鐵劍。

cast.noteEn: Hatless dwarven master with a twin-forked ginger beard and brass runes. Tests Kai's honest hard work before forging his Dwarven steel armor and math runes.
cast.noteZh: 沒有戴頭盔、留著火紅雙叉鬍與黃銅符文圍裙的矮人鐵匠宗師。考驗凱勤勞誠懇的態度後，為他打造矮人鋼甲並傳授加減乘除魔法。

cast.roleZh: 迷失方向的秩序守護者

cast.noteZh: 原本是守護王國的秩序使者，卻被人們草率混亂的壞程式碼纏繞而黑化。擊碎他黑暗的外殼後，裡面沉睡的真正守護者終於重獲自由。

cast.roleZh: 蟒蛇王國真正的守護小精靈
cast.noteEn: A tiny spring-emerald baby praying mantis with bright gentle eyes who hatches from the cracked dark shell at dawn, restoring peace to Pythonia.
cast.noteZh: 從破裂的黑殼中搖搖晃晃走出的翠綠小螳螂精靈，有著清澈明亮的大眼睛，在黎明曙光中與凱和 String 一起迎接和平。

storyParts.titleEn: Prologue: The Glitch, the Gentle Heart & the Bug King
storyParts.titleZh: 序章：螢幕裂縫、溫柔的心與蟲蟲魔王的由來
storyParts.subtitleEn: Why Pythonia chose a kind coder instead of the fastest player
storyParts.subtitleZh: 為什麼魔法王國選擇了願意停下來幫忙的孩子
storyParts.imageAltEn: Hero Kai beside the Great Wizard on the sunlit entry road to Silent Village with an emerald portal in the mountain mist
storyParts.imageAltZh: 小英雄凱與大法師站在通往靜默村莊的陽光小路上，遠方山霧中有翠綠色的傳送漩渦
paragraphsEn: Late one afternoon, 11-year-old Kai was at his computer playing his favorite adventure game. Suddenly, a classmate in the game got stuck. Instead of rushing ahead to win by himself, Kai paused calmly and typed a kind message to help.

WHOOSH! A swirling vortex of emerald light opened right inside his monitor! It pulled Kai through a dazzling Virtual City of floating letters and numbers and set him gently down on a quiet dirt road in a magical land called Pythonia.
Kai blinked. His bedroom was gone! He wore an olive-green cloak with a golden crescent clasp, a lotus medallion belt, a wooden sword, and an empty Ancient Spellbook glowing warm gold in his hands.

An old Great Wizard hurried over with relief. He pointed toward a dark mountain far away and explained that Pythonia's Steward of Order had been twisted by careless, messy, unkind code into the fearful Bug King—who locked away all Eleven Ancient Spells.
paragraphsZh: 一天傍晚，十一歲的凱正在電腦前玩他最喜歡的冒險遊戲。突然，遊戲裡有一位同學卡關了。凱沒有急著自己衝向終點，而是靜下心停下腳步，打出溫暖的訊息去幫忙。
刷的一聲！電腦螢幕裡突然打開了一道閃耀的翠綠色光影漩渦！光圈將凱拉進一座漂浮著文字與數字的「虛擬之城」，接著輕輕把他放在魔法王國「蟒蛇王國（Pythonia）」的泥土小路上。
凱眨了眨眼，他的房間不見了！他身上穿著配有金色新月扣環的橄欖綠披風、蓮花徽章腰帶、背著一把木劍，手裡還捧著一本散發金色微光的空白《古老咒語書》。
一位慈祥的大法師急忙走來，鬆了一口氣。他指向遠方的黑山，告訴凱：從前王國的「秩序守護者」被人們草率、自私又雜亂的壞程式碼纏住，變成可怕的「蟲蟲魔王」，把十一道古老善咒全都鎖了起來。

dialogue.lineEn: "Why me? I'm not the fastest or strongest player."
dialogue.lineZh: 「為什麼是我？我既不是跑得最快的，也不是最強的玩家。」

dialogue.lineEn: "Anyone can swing a sword. We called for someone who knows how to pause, stay calm, and care for others. Your Spellbook answered your kind heart."
dialogue.lineZh: 「誰都能揮動木劍。我們等待的，是懂得停下來、保持冷靜、並且關心別人的人。你的咒語書回應了你善良的心。」

scenes.advanceSectionZh: 序章：螢幕裂縫、溫柔的心與蟲蟲魔王的由來
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Late one afternoon, Kai was at his computer playing his favorite adventure game. Suddenly, his screen glitched—not because he broke anything, but because a classmate in the game got stuck and Kai paused to help them instead of rushing ahead.

As Kai took a calm breath and typed a kind message, a swirling vortex of emerald light opened right inside his monitor!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
一天傍晚，凱正坐在電腦前玩著他最喜歡的冒險遊戲。突然間，螢幕閃起了一道奇異的訊號——並不是因為他弄壞了什麼，而是因為遊戲裡一位同學卡關了，凱選擇停下腳步去幫忙，而不是自顧自地往前衝。

就在凱深吸一口氣、靜心打出一則溫暖訊息的那一刻，螢幕正中央突然旋轉展開了一道璀璨的翠綠色光影漩渦！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Hold on—don't worry. I'll pause here and help you get through this first."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「別擔心，我先停下來陪你一起過關。」

scenes.titleEn: Swept Through the Virtual City Vortex
scenes.titleZh: 穿越虛擬之城光影漩渦
scenes.narrationEn: The emerald vortex pulled Kai through a dazzling Virtual City of floating letters and numbers, dressing him in an olive-green cloak, wooden sword, and an empty gold-glowing Ancient Spellbook.
scenes.narrationZh: 翠綠漩渦拉著凱穿過漂浮著文字與數字的「虛擬之城」，替他換上橄欖綠披風、木劍，手裡也出現一本發光的空白《古老咒語書》。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Whoa—where am I?"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「哇——這裡是哪裡？」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
The emerald vortex pulled Kai straight through a dazzling Virtual City of floating letters, glowing numbers, and woven streams of light before setting him gently down on a quiet dirt road in Pythonia.

Kai blinked in wonder. His bedroom was completely gone. Instead, he found himself wearing an olive-green cloak, a wooden sword at his side, and holding an empty Ancient Spellbook already warming in his hands.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
翠綠色的光影漩渦拉著凱穿越了一座飄浮著字母、數字與光流符號的炫目「虛擬之城」，最後溫柔地將他送到蟒蛇王國一條安靜的泥土小路上。

凱眨了眨眼，驚訝地發現自己的房間不見了——取而代之的是一身橄欖綠披風、腰間的木劍，還有一本正在掌心散發暖光的空白《古老咒語書》。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Whoa... my bedroom is gone! Where did this glowing Spellbook come from?"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「哇……我的房間不見了！這本發光的咒語書是哪裡來的？」

scenes.titleEn: The Great Wizard & Story of the Bug King
scenes.titleZh: 大法師與蟲蟲魔王的由來
scenes.narrationEn: An old Great Wizard hurried up in relief, pointing toward the dark mountain. Careless, unkind code had twisted Pythonia's Steward of Order into the Bug King—and Kai's Spellbook had answered his kind heart.
scenes.narrationZh: 慈祥的大法師鬆了一口氣地迎上來，指向遠方的黑山，告訴凱人們混亂自私的程式碼把秩序守護者變成了蟲蟲魔王，而咒語書回應了凱善良的心。
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Your Spellbook answered your kind heart."
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「你的咒語書回應了你善良的心。」
scenes.mood: hopeful warmth tempered by distant mystery
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
An old Great Wizard hurried down the road toward him, eyes wide with relief. Pointing first to the warm gold glow in Kai's Spellbook and then toward a distant dark mountain, the Wizard revealed Pythonia's sorrow.

"Long ago, Pythonia's Steward of Order kept every river, forest, and village running in harmony," he explained. "But people grew careless. They left broken words, greedy shortcuts, and tangled rules everywhere. All that messy, unkind code twisted around the Steward until fear and static swallowed him whole—turning him into the Bug King! He locked away the Eleven Ancient Spells so no one could make more broken magic."
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
一位年邁的大法師鬆了一口氣、急忙沿著小路迎上前來。他先指向凱手中泛著暖金光芒的咒語書，接著望向遠方黑暗的山脈，娓娓道出王國的危機。

「很久以前，秩序守護者曾讓蟒蛇王國的每一條河流、森林與村莊和諧運作。」大法師說：「但後來人們變得粗心大意，到處留下殘缺的文字、貪心的捷徑和混亂的規則。那些自私又雜亂的程式碼纏住了守護者，讓恐懼與雜訊吞沒了他的心——他因此變成了『蟲蟲魔王』，鎖起了十一道古老善咒。」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "All that messy, unkind code swallowed the Steward—turning him into the Bug King!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「混亂又自私的程式碼吞噬了守護者，使他變成了蟲蟲魔王！」

scenes.titleZh: 邁向靜默村莊的旅程
scenes.narrationEn: Encouraged by the Great Wizard, Kai tucked his glowing Spellbook close and stepped bravely down the quiet dirt road toward Silent Village.
scenes.narrationZh: 在大法師溫柔的鼓勵下，凱抱緊閃耀微光的咒語書，勇敢地沿著泥土小路朝著被薄霧籠罩的靜默村莊出發。
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Every great wizard begins with a single kind word."
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「每一位偉大的法師，都從一句溫暖的話開始。」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
"Why me?" Kai asked quietly. "I'm not the fastest or strongest player."

The Great Wizard smiled softly. "Anyone can swing a sword. We called for someone who knows how to pause, stay calm, and care for others. Your Spellbook answered your kind heart." Holding the glowing book close, Kai stepped bravely down the path toward Silent Village.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
「為什麼是我呢？」凱輕聲問道：「我既不是跑得最快，也不是最強的玩家。」

大法師溫柔地微笑：「任誰都能揮舞寶劍。我們召喚的，是懂得停下腳步、保持冷靜、並且真心關懷他人的人。你的咒語書回應了你善良的心。」凱抱緊發光的書本，勇敢地沿著泥土路走向靜默村莊。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Anyone can swing a sword. Your Spellbook answered your kind heart."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「任誰都能揮舞寶劍，但你的咒語書回應了你善良的心。」

Dressed in an olive cloak with a wooden sword and a gold-glowing empty Spellbook, Kai learned from the Great Wizard how careless, tangled code had twisted Pythonia's Steward of Order into the fearsome Bug King.
"Anyone can swing a sword," the Wizard smiled softly. "Your Spellbook answered your calm, caring heart."
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 某個傍晚，凱在遊戲裡選擇停下來耐心安慰並幫助卡關的同學，這個溫柔舉動打開了電腦螢幕裡的翠綠漩渦，帶他穿過虛擬之城來到蟒蛇王國。
換上橄欖綠披風、手持木劍與散發金光的空白古書，凱從大法師口中得知：人們粗心混亂的程式碼把秩序守護者變成了蟲蟲魔王。
「任誰都能揮舞寶劍，」大法師溫柔微笑道：「但你的咒語書，回應了你靜心行善的心。」

storyParts.titleZh: 第一章：VOICE 聲音咒 — 喚醒靜默村莊的微笑
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 1: print("Hello!") · Speak kindness to lift the fog
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第一咒：print("Hello!") · 用一句溫暖的問候驅散迷霧
storyParts.imageAltEn: Misty cobblestone square of Silent Village with its mossy stone well, glowing lanterns, and emerald mountain portal
storyParts.imageAltZh: 霧氣繚繞的靜默村莊石板廣場，有長滿青苔的石井、暖色燈籠與遠方的翠綠山谷傳送門
paragraphsEn: Kai and the Great Wizard walked into Silent Village, where a cold grey hush hung over the cobblestone square. Barnaby the Baker waved silently behind his counter, and a little girl tried to greet Kai, but not even a whisper came out.
Kai didn't pull out his sword. Instead, he knelt gently beside the frightened child to comfort her. Right away, his Spellbook flipped open to the glowing Mouth symbol: print().

Kai took a steady breath, pointed toward the misty well, and cast print("Hello!"). POP! A bluebird sang from the roof, Barnaby's cheerful laugh rang out, and warm golden sunlight broke through the grey clouds!

The villagers cheered! Happy to meet them, Kai tried to say a long sentence—but his magic stuttered one tiny word at a time: "I." ... "Glad." ... "Meet." The Great Wizard smiled and pointed toward a colorful ribbon-draped treeline called Loom Forest.
paragraphsZh: 凱與大法師走進靜默村莊，灰濛濛的靜寂籠罩著整座廣場。麵包師巴納比在櫃檯後默默揮手，一位小女孩想跟凱打招呼，卻怎麼樣也發不出半點聲音。
凱沒有拔劍，而是溫柔地蹲下身安慰害怕的小女孩。就在這一刻，他的《古老咒語書》自動翻開，出現了閃耀的嘴巴符號：print()。
凱深吸一口氣，唸出第一道魔法：print("Hello!")。啵的一聲！屋頂上的藍雀唱起歌，巴納比爽朗的笑聲響遍廣場，溫暖的陽光也穿透了濃霧！
村民們開心地歡呼！凱想回應大家，但魔法卻只能一個字一個字斷斷續續地跳出來：「我。」……「高興。」……「見面。」大法師微笑著指向遠方掛滿彩帶的樹林——「織錦森林」。

dialogue.lineEn: "Every great wizard begins with a single kind word. Follow those rainbow ribbons—they will lead you to the Weaver's Loom."
dialogue.lineZh: 「每一位偉大的法師，都是從一句溫柔的問候開始的。沿著那些彩虹絲帶走，它們會帶你找到織布機。」

dialogue.lineEn: "I... Glad... Meet... Oh no, my words won't stay together!"
dialogue.lineZh: 「我……高興……見面……糟糕，我的句子黏不起來！」

scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Kai and the Great Wizard walked into Silent Village, where a heavy grey hush hung low over the cobblestone square.

Barnaby the Baker waved silently behind his shop counter, unable to call out his morning greetings. Nearby, a little girl hurried up and opened her mouth to greet Kai—but not even a faint whisper came out into the fog.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱與大法師走進靜默村莊時，一層沉重的灰色寂靜正籠罩在石板廣場上。

麵包師巴納比只能站在櫃檯後默默揮手，連早安都喊不出來；廣場旁，一位小女孩小跑上前想向凱打招呼，張開嘴巴卻連一絲微弱的氣音都發不出來。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Narrator: "Not a single laugh, greeting, or birdsong could pierce the grey hush."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 旁白：「沒有一聲歡笑、一句問候或一聲鳥鳴，能穿透這片灰色的寂靜。」

scenes.titleZh: 安慰女孩與嘴巴符號甦醒
scenes.narrationEn: Kai didn't draw his sword. Instead, he knelt gently to comfort the frightened child—and his Spellbook flipped open to the glowing golden Mouth symbol: print().
scenes.narrationZh: 凱沒有拔出木劍，而是溫柔地蹲下身安慰害怕的小女孩。就在這一刻，他的咒語書翻開，亮起了金色的嘴巴符號：print()！
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Every great wizard begins with a single kind word."
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「每一位偉大的法師，都從一句溫暖的話開始。」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Kai didn't draw his wooden sword or raise his voice in frustration. Instead, he dropped gently to one knee right in front of the frightened child to comfort her.

The instant his kindness warmed the silent air, his Ancient Spellbook flipped open on its own to a bright page bearing the glowing Mouth symbol: print().
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
面對無聲的霧氣，凱沒有拔出木劍，也沒有焦急抱怨。相反地，他輕輕單膝跪在害怕的小女孩面前，溫柔地安撫她。

就在這份體貼照亮空氣的瞬間，凱手中的《古老咒語書》自動翻開，書頁上亮起了一枚閃耀的「嘴巴」符印：print()。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Every great wizard begins with a single kind word."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「每一位偉大的法師，都從一句溫暖善良的話開始。」

scenes.titleZh: 第一道聲音魔法：print("Hello!")
scenes.narrationEn: Kai took a steady breath and cast: print("Hello!") POP! A bluebird sang, Barnaby's cheerful laugh rang out, and warm sunlight broke right through the mist!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱穩住呼吸，施展第一道咒語：print("Hello!")！啵的一聲，藍雀高聲歌唱，巴納比爽朗地大笑，溫暖陽光瞬間穿透濃霧！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "print('Hello!')"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print('Hello!')」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Guided by the Great Wizard's steady nod, Kai took a slow, calm breath, raised his hand toward the misty village well, and cast his very first Pythonia spell: print("Hello!").

POP! A bright bluebird burst into clear song on the rooftop, Barnaby the Baker's cheerful laugh echoed across the square, and warm golden sunlight broke straight through the grey mist!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
在大法師沉穩的點頭鼓勵下，凱靜心深呼吸，朝著霧氣瀰漫的古老石井伸出手，唸出他在蟒蛇王國的第一道咒語：print("Hello!")。

「啵！」一聲，屋頂上的藍鳥清脆高歌，麵包師巴納比開朗的笑聲迴盪廣場，溫暖的金色陽光瞬間穿透濃霧灑落下來！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "print('Hello!')" · Barnaby the Baker: "Aha! My voice—everyone can hear me again!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print('Hello!')」· 麵包師巴納比：「太好了！我的聲音回來了，大家都能聽見我說話了！」

scenes.titleEn: One-Word Stutter & Pointing to Loom Forest
scenes.titleZh: 單字卡頓與指引織錦森林
scenes.narrationEn: Kai tried to thank everyone, but his magic stuttered one word at a time: "I." ... "Glad." ... "Meet." The Great Wizard smiled and pointed toward Loom Forest, where rainbow ribbons fluttered.
scenes.narrationZh: 凱開心地想謝謝大家，魔法卻只能一個字一個字跳出來：「我。」「高興。」「見面。」大法師笑著指向遠方掛滿彩虹絲帶的「織錦森林」。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "I... Glad... Meet... My words won't stay together!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「我……高興……見面……我的話黏不起來！」
scenes.spellCode: # Single-word stutter -> Go to Loom Forest
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 篇章插曲：前往織錦森林的旅程
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
The villagers cheered and thanked Kai, and Kai tried happily to reply: "I am so glad to meet you all!" But the magic stuttered! "I." Kai paused and tried again. "Glad." Once more: "Meet."

Speaking only one word at a time made his thoughts crumble before finishing a single sentence! Hurrying back to ask the Great Wizard why, the Wizard pointed his staff toward a distant emerald treeline: "A single thread of magic is weak on its own, Kai. Follow the thousands of colorful ribbons fluttering in Loom Forest—they will lead you straight to the Weaver's Loom!" Tightening his backpack, Kai set off beneath tall pines swaying with rainbow ribbons of silk and light.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
村民們歡呼著感謝凱，凱開心地想回應大家：「我很高興遇見你們！」沒想到魔法卻結巴了起來：「我。」凱停下來再試一次：「高興。」又試了一次：「遇見。」

一次只能吐出一個詞，讓他連一句完整的問候都說不完！凱連忙跑去請教大法師，大法師微笑著將法杖指向遠方翠綠的樹梢：「單獨一條魔法絲線太脆弱了。去織錦森林吧——那裡有成千上萬條隨風飄揚的彩色絲帶，會引領你找到織布大師的織布機。」凱背好行囊，朝著飄滿絲帶與光影的松林小徑出發。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "I. ... Glad. ... Meet." · Great Wizard: "Follow the colorful ribbons into Loom Forest!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「我……高興……遇見。」· 大法師：「跟著飄揚的彩虹絲帶走進織錦森林吧！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Inside Silent Village, a grey hush muted Barnaby the Baker and a frightened little girl. Rather than drawing his sword, Kai knelt gently to comfort the child—awakening the Mouth spell print() inside his Spellbook.

Casting print("Hello!") popped bluebird songs and sunlit laughter across the square, yet Kai's reply stuttered one word at a time ("I. Glad. Meet."). Pointing toward rainbow silk ribbons swaying in Loom Forest, the Great Wizard sent Kai onward to seek the Weaver's Loom.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 走進被灰霧靜音的靜默村莊，連麵包師巴納比和小女孩都發不出半點聲音。凱沒有拔劍，而是先蹲下來輕聲安慰害怕的孩子——因而喚醒了書頁上的開口咒 print()。
當凱唸出 print("Hello!") 讓陽光照亮村莊後，他想回答村民卻一個字一個字地結巴起來。大法師便指向遠處飄滿彩虹絲帶的松林，指引凱前往織錦森林學習編織句子的魔法。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 2: WEAVE — Grandma Looma's Cottage & the Friendly Pup
storyParts.titleZh: 第二章：WEAVE 編織咒 — 魯瑪奶奶的木屋與小黃狗
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 2: print("Hello", "Pythonia!") · Join words with neat space
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第二咒：print("Hello", "Pythonia!") · 用逗號留下剛好的呼吸空間
storyParts.imageAltEn: Grandma Looma smiling warmly beside her giant wooden tapestry loom lit by a glowing hanging lantern
storyParts.imageAltZh: 魯瑪奶奶在掛著暖光燈籠的巨大木頭織布機旁露出慈祥的笑容
paragraphsEn: Kai walked down the winding dirt path beneath tall whispering pines. Tied to every branch were thousands of colorful silk ribbons swaying in the breeze like living rainbows.

Following the fluttering trail, Kai reached a cozy wooden cottage draped in woven banners. Inside, kind Grandma Looma worked at a giant oak loom—and a scruffy, unnamed golden-tan puppy trotted right up to sniff Kai's boots!

"Hello." ... "Name." ... "Kai." he blurted out slowly. Grandma Looma laughed gently and held up her carved wooden shuttle. She showed him that weaving a comma , between words stitches them into one warm sentence with a neat, friendly space between every neighbor.

Kai held up the glowing green thread and cast print("Hello", "Pythonia!"). At last, his words flowed smoothly! He thanked Grandma Looma, gave the cheerful golden puppy a gentle pat on the head, and set off down the sunny trail with his new furry friend trotting beside him.
paragraphsZh: 凱沿著彎曲的泥土小路走進高聳的松林，枝頭上繫著成千上萬條彩色絲帶，在微風中像會跳舞的彩虹一樣飄揚。
順著絲帶，凱來到一間掛滿手工掛毯的溫暖木屋。屋裡慈祥的魯瑪奶奶正操作著巨大的橡木織布機，還有一隻毛茸茸、尚未取名的金黃色小狗搖著尾巴跑來聞凱的靴子！
「你好。」……「名字。」……「凱。」他結結巴巴地說。魯瑪奶奶溫柔地笑著拿起木梭告訴他：只要在詞語之間放進「逗號 ,」，魔法就會自動留下剛剛好又舒服的間隔，把話織成一塊完整的暖布。
凱舉起發光的綠色絲線，唸出 print("Hello", "Pythonia!")。終於，句子流暢地說出口了！他向魯瑪奶奶道謝，摸摸小黃狗的頭，和小夥伴一起踏上新的旅程。

dialogue.lineEn: "A single thread cannot keep anyone warm, young apprentice. Weave your words with a comma, and every neighbor gets comfortable breathing room!"
dialogue.lineZh: 「單獨一條線沒辦法讓人保暖喔，小法師。用逗號把字詞織在一起，每個字之間都會有舒服的空間！」

spell.nameZh: 第二咒：WEAVE 編織魔法 — 逗號 (,)
spell.explainEn: A comma (,) inside print() joins multiple strings and automatically puts one neat space between them.
spell.explainZh: 在 print() 裡放進逗號 (,)，就能把好幾段文字連在一起說，而且會自動加上一個空格喔！

spell.demoOutputZh: Hello Pythonia!  ✨（流暢、溫暖，間隔剛剛好！）

scenes.narrationZh: 凱拉緊背包走進高聳的松林，枝頭上繫著成千上萬條像活彩虹般飄揚的絲帶，一路指引他來到溫馨的織布木屋。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "So many living rainbows!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「好多會跳舞的彩虹絲帶！」

Following the fluttering trail of colorful ribbons deeper into Loom Forest, Kai walked beneath ancient pines draped in silk banners of crimson, emerald, and gold.

Every gentle breeze carried soft chimes from the woven streamers overhead, guiding Kai step by step into a warm, sunlit clearing.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
順著空中飄揚的七彩絲帶一路深入織錦森林，凱走進了掛滿翠綠、金黃與緋紅綢緞的古老松林。

微風拂過時，枝頭上的絲帶輕輕搖曳作響，一步一步將凱引向森林深處一座灑滿陽光的溫暖林間空地。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Thousands of ribbons... the Great Wizard was right. The trail is leading straight ahead!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「好幾千條彩色絲帶……大法師說得沒錯，這條路就在前方引領著我！」

scenes.titleZh: 魯瑪奶奶的織布機與無名小黃狗

scenes.narrationZh: 木屋裡，慈祥的魯瑪奶奶正在巨大的橡木織布機前安靜工作——還有一隻友善、還沒取名字的金黃色小狗跑來聞凱的靴子！
scenes.dialogueEn: Grandma Looma: "A single thread cannot keep anyone warm."
scenes.dialogueZh: 魯瑪奶奶：「單獨一條線是沒辦法讓人保暖的喔。」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
At the end of the ribbon trail stood a cozy wooden cottage draped in woven banners, where old Grandma Looma sat working calmly at a giant oak loom—while a friendly, unnamed golden-tan pup trotted right up to sniff Kai's boots.

"Hello." ... "Name." ... "Kai." Kai blurted out, stumbling one word at a time. Grandma Looma smiled gently: "A single thread cannot keep anyone warm, young apprentice. Words are just like thread—weave them together with a comma ,, and Pythonia leaves a neat, comfortable space between them so they become a whole cloth!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
絲帶盡頭是一座掛滿織錦旗幟的溫馨木屋。慈祥的魯瑪奶奶正坐在巨大的橡木織布機前專心紡織，而一隻友善卻還沒取名的小黃狗，立刻搖著尾巴跑上前聞了聞凱的靴子。

scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Grandma Looma: "Weave words together with a comma , and Pythonia leaves a neat space between them!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 魯瑪奶奶：「用逗號 , 把詞語編織起來，蟒蛇王國就會貼心地在詞語之間留出舒適的空格！」

scenes.titleZh: 逗號編織：print("Hello", "Pythonia!")
scenes.narrationEn: Holding up the glowing green comma thread, Kai cast print("Hello", "Pythonia!"). At last, his words flowed together in one smooth, warm sentence!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱舉起發光的綠色逗號絲線，唸出 print("Hello", "Pythonia!")。終於，詞語順暢地織成一句溫暖又完整的話！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Hello, Pythonia! My words flowed together!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「Hello, Pythonia！我的話順利織在一起了！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Holding up the glowing green thread between his fingers, Kai linked his greetings smoothly with Grandma Looma's comma rune and cast: print("Hello", "Pythonia!").

At last, his words flowed together in one smooth, warm sentence—each word connected yet resting comfortably side by side without crowding!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱舉起指尖閃耀微光的綠色織線，運用魯瑪奶奶教導的逗號魔法將詞彙串連起來，念出咒語：print("Hello", "Pythonia!")。

終於，他的話語像順滑的錦緞般一口氣流淌出來——兩個詞既緊密相連，中間又保留了乾淨溫暖的呼吸距離！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "print('Hello', 'Pythonia!') — It worked! My words flow smoothly together!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print('Hello', 'Pythonia!') ——成功了！我的話語終於能流暢地連成一句溫暖的話！」

scenes.titleEn: Setting Off Toward the Rocky Valley
scenes.titleZh: 告別魯瑪奶奶出發
scenes.narrationEn: Kai thanked Grandma Looma, gave the cheerful pup an affectionate pat on the head, and waved goodbye as the two of them stepped back out onto the sunlit trail.
scenes.narrationZh: 凱向魯瑪奶奶道謝，溫柔摸摸小黃狗的頭，揮手告別後和小夥伴一起走回陽光燦爛的林間小路。
scenes.dialogueEn: Grandma Looma: "Weave your words like warm cloth!"

Glowing with pride, Kai thanked Grandma Looma warmly, knelt to give the friendly unnamed pup a cheerful pat on the head, and waved goodbye.

As the two of them stepped back out onto the sunlit forest trail, the little golden-tan pup stayed right at Kai's heels—already eager for their next horizon toward the distant rocky valley.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱開懷地向魯瑪奶奶道謝，蹲下身輕輕拍拍這隻還沒取名的小黃狗的腦袋，笑著揮手道別。

當一人一狗重新踏上陽光燦爛的林間小路時，小黃狗已經一步也不離開凱的腳邊，精神抖擻地準備一起迎向遠方充滿迴音的岩石山谷。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Thank you, Grandma Looma! Come on, little buddy—let's see where the sunlit trail goes!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「謝謝您，魯瑪奶奶！走吧，小夥伴，我們一起去看看陽光小路的盡頭有什麼！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Following fluttering rainbow ribbons beneath whispering pines, Kai reached Grandma Looma's cozy cottage, where an unnamed golden-tan pup trotted warmly up to greet his boots.

Teaching him that single threads can keep nobody warm, Grandma Looma showed Kai how the Comma Weave (,) gives words comfortable breathing room: print("Hello", "Pythonia!")—and with smooth speech restored, Kai and the faithful pup marched onward together.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 順著飄揚的彩虹絲帶走進森林深處，凱來到魯瑪奶奶掛滿布幔的小木屋，還遇見一隻親切討喜、尚未取名的小黃狗。
魯瑪奶奶溫柔教導凱「單線難成暖衣」，學會用逗號編織咒 , 留出舒服的詞距後，凱順暢唸出 print("Hello", "Pythonia!")，帶著緊跟在身邊的小黃狗歡喜朝下一站邁進。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 3: FUSE — The Iron Outpost & the Forged Sword
storyParts.titleZh: 第三章：FUSE 熔合咒 — 鋼鐵前哨與無縫寶劍
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 3: print("Iron" + "Sword") · Melt pieces into one solid blade
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第三咒：print("Iron" + "Sword") · 用加號把兩半熔成一體
storyParts.imageAltEn: Open-air brick forge at the Iron Outpost with glowing sparks flying above the anvil where a sword fuses together
storyParts.imageAltZh: 鋼鐵前哨的露天磚造鍛爐，鐵砧上火花四濺，兩半斷劍正熔合成一體
paragraphsEn: The dirt trail led Kai and the puppy out of the pine woods into a rocky valley smelling of hot steel and charcoal smoke. CLANG! CLANG! CLANG! echoed off the canyon walls.

In the dust, Kai tripped over two broken halves of an ancient iron sword. Remembering Grandma Looma's lesson, he cast print("Iron", "Sword"). Sparks popped—but it left a big airy gap right in the middle: Iron Sword! A blade with a gap in the middle would break right away in battle.

Towering sparks flew from the open doors of the Iron Outpost ahead. The burly horned Blacksmith looked up from his glowing anvil and boomed out the secret: threads leave spaces for chatting, but metal needs the Plus Sign + to FUSE with zero gaps!

Kai gripped his Spellbook, tapped the anvil, and cast print("Iron" + "Sword"). CLANG! In a shower of amber sparks, the two halves melted into one solid, gleaming IronSword—and Kai belted it safely at his waist while the puppy wagged his tail.
paragraphsZh: 泥土小路帶著凱和小黃狗走出松林，來到充滿熱鐵與木炭香氣的岩石山谷。鏗！鏗！鏗！打鐵聲在山壁間迴盪。
凱在路邊被兩截斷掉的古代鐵劍絆了一跤。他想起魯瑪奶奶的教導，試著施展 print("Iron", "Sword")。火花閃了一下，結果兩半之間卻留下一個空隙：Iron Sword！中間有洞的劍可沒辦法用來保護大家。
前方鋼鐵前哨的大門噴出高高的火花。頭戴雙角鐵盔、留著三股銀白辮子鬍的壯碩鐵匠大聲笑著指點他：織布講話需要空格，但鍛造金屬必須用「加號 +」才能完美熔合，不留一點縫隙！
凱握緊咒語書敲向鐵砧，唸出 print("Iron" + "Sword")。鏗的一聲！兩截斷鐵在金黃火花中融合成一把閃亮堅固的「IronSword」，凱開心將寶劍繫在腰間。

scenes.titleEn: The Shattered Iron Sword on the Valley Road
scenes.titleZh: 山谷路上的斷裂鐵劍
scenes.narrationEn: Down into a smoky rocky valley echoing with CLANG! CLANG!, Kai tripped right over two shattered halves of an ancient iron sword half-buried in the dust.
scenes.narrationZh: 走出松林來到充滿炭火煙味的岩石山谷，鏗！鏗！打鐵聲迴盪在谷間，凱一不小心被半埋在土裡的兩截古代斷劍絆倒了！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Whoa—a broken ancient blade!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「哇——是一把斷掉的古代鐵劍！」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 3. FUSE — The Iron Outpost (Plus Sign = Melt Together = +)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 三、FUSE 熔合咒 — 鋼鐵前哨站（熔合加號：+）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
The winding dirt path carried Kai and the golden-tan pup out of the whispering pines and down into a rocky canyon where the air smelled of hot steel and charcoal smoke, echoing with a rhythmic CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!.

Down on the valley floor, Kai tripped over two shattered halves of an ancient iron sword. Trying Grandma Looma's comma weave—print("Iron", "Sword")—only left an awkward, airy gap in midair: Iron Sword! That wouldn't hold together in battle at all!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
蜿蜒的小路帶著凱與小黃狗走出松林，進入了一座瀰漫著灼熱鐵味與木炭煙霧的岩石峽谷，崖壁間迴盪著整齊響亮的「鏘！鏘！鏘！」打鐵聲。

就在路邊塵土裡，凱被一柄斷成兩截的古老鐵劍絆了一跤。他試著套用魯瑪奶奶教的逗號編織——print("Iron", "Sword")——結果空中卻出現了一道尷尬的縫隙：Iron Sword！分開成兩截的劍根本沒辦法用來作戰啊！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Oh no—the comma left an airy gap: 'Iron Sword'! How do I fuse broken metal?"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「糟了——逗號在中間留下了空隙，變成分開的 'Iron Sword'！要怎麼把金屬緊密熔合呢？」

scenes.titleEn: The Burly Blacksmith at the Iron Outpost
scenes.titleZh: 鋼鐵前哨的壯碩鐵匠
scenes.narrationEn: Kai tried Grandma Looma's comma—print("Iron", "Sword")—but it left an awkward gap between the blades! Ahead, the burly horned Blacksmith boomed: "Metal needs + to FUSE with zero gaps!"
scenes.narrationZh: 凱試著用逗號施展 print("Iron", "Sword")，兩半劍身之間卻留下一個尷尬的空隙！前方的雙角銀鬍鐵匠豪邁喊道：「金屬要用加號 + 才能無縫熔合！」
scenes.dialogueEn: Blacksmith: "Metal needs + to FUSE with zero gaps!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 前哨鐵匠：「鍛造金屬必須用加號 +，才能一絲不漏地熔合！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Ahead, towering orange sparks poured through the wide doorway of the Iron Outpost.

Looking up from his glowing anvil, the burly Blacksmith boomed out in a voice like rolling thunder: "Threads leave spaces! That's fine for chatting, young wizard, but metal needs the Plus Sign + to FUSE—melt two pieces into one solid blade with zero gaps!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
前方不遠處的「鋼鐵前哨站」大門敞開，裡頭不斷飛濺出耀眼的金色火花。

壯碩的鐵匠從熾熱的鐵砧前抬起頭，聲音像打雷般洪亮地大喊：「絲線才會留空隙！聊天交談時留空格很好，但鍛造金屬必須用『加號 +』來進行『FUSE 熔合』——把兩塊斷鐵融成一把毫無縫隙的堅固寶劍！」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Blacksmith: "Metal needs the Plus Sign + to FUSE—melt two pieces into one solid blade with zero gaps!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 前哨鐵匠：「金屬必須靠『加號 +』來熔合，才能把兩塊碎鐵鑄成一把完全沒有縫隙的實心寶劍！」

scenes.titleZh: 敲響鐵砧：print("Iron" + "Sword")
scenes.narrationEn: Kai gripped his Spellbook, stepped up to the anvil, and cast: print("Iron" + "Sword")—CLANG!—melting both shattered halves into one gleaming, solid IronSword!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱握緊咒語書踏向鐵砧，施展 print("Iron" + "Sword")——鏗！——兩截斷劍在金色火花中瞬間熔合成一把閃亮堅固的 IronSword！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "print('Iron' + 'Sword')!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print('Iron' + 'Sword')！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Gripping his Ancient Spellbook tightly, Kai stepped up to the blazing anvil, aimed his wand right between the broken iron halves, and cast the FUSE spell: print("Iron" + "Sword").

CLANG! Bright golden fire roared across the steel—and right before his eyes, the two shattered halves melted seamlessly together into one gleaming, unbroken IronSword!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱握緊《古老咒語書》，大步站到閃爍金光的鐵砧前，舉起魔杖對準斷裂的劍身，果斷揮出熔合咒語：print("Iron" + "Sword")。

「鏘！」一聲巨響，金色烈焰瞬間包覆鐵片——就在眼前，原本斷成兩半的金屬徹底融為一體，化作一把寒光閃閃、毫無接縫的堅固鐵劍 IronSword！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "print('Iron' + 'Sword')!" · Blacksmith: "Haha! Zero gaps—now THAT is forged steel!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print('Iron' + 'Sword')！」· 前哨鐵匠：「哈哈！一點縫隙都沒有——這才叫真正千錘百鍊的好劍！」

scenes.titleZh: 佩掛鐵劍步入暮色森林
scenes.narrationEn: With his gleaming IronSword securely belted at his waist and the faithful golden pup trotting at his heels, Kai waved goodbye to the Blacksmith as they entered the twilight woods.
scenes.narrationZh: 凱將閃亮堅固的 IronSword 繫在腰間，與忠心緊隨在後的小黃狗一起向鐵匠道別，走進幽靜的暮色森林。
scenes.dialogueEn: Blacksmith: "Solid as rock, young wizard!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 前哨鐵匠：「堅固得像磐石一樣，小法師！」
scenes.mood: warm pride transitioning to quiet mystery
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
With his gleaming IronSword securely belted at his waist and the loyal golden-tan pup trotting joyfully beside him, Kai waved goodbye to the burly Blacksmith.

Soon the rhythmic CLANG! CLANG! of the Outpost faded behind them as the rocky canyon gave way to a dense, twilight canopy of ancient moss-draped trees.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱把閃閃發光的無縫鐵劍 IronSword 牢牢佩掛在腰間，向豪爽的鐵匠揮手道別。

小黃狗開心地緊跟在後，身後「鏘、鏘」的打鐵聲漸漸遠去，岩石峽谷也慢慢轉變為一片藤蔓低垂、神秘幽深的暮色古樹林。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "IronSword feels strong and steady! Ready to explore those twilight woods ahead?"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「佩上鐵劍感覺好踏實！小夥伴，準備好一起走進前面那片暮色森林了嗎？」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Down in the smoky canyon of the Iron Outpost, Kai found two broken sword halves and learned why Grandma Looma's comma left an airy gap (Iron Sword) unsuitable for steel.
Beside roaring anvil sparks, the burly Blacksmith boomed out the secret of FUSE (+): print("Iron" + "Sword") melted both shattered pieces seamlessly into one solid, gleaming IronSword!
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 在煙霧與打鐵聲迴盪的鋼鐵前哨峽谷裡，凱發現斷成兩半的古鐵劍，並明白用逗號會在劍身留下鬆散空隙。
在火星四濺的鐵砧前，壯碩鐵匠洪亮傳授「FUSE 熔合咒 +」：一聲 print("Iron" + "Sword") 化作金焰，把斷鐵無縫鑄成一把光亮堅實的 IronSword！

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 4: LISTEN — Whispering Forest & Naming String
storyParts.titleZh: 第四章：LISTEN 傾聽咒 — 低語森林與「字串」誕生
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 4: input("What is your name? ") · Pause and listen for a reply
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第四咒：input("What is your name? ") · 靜下來等待對方的回答
storyParts.imageAltEn: A luminous blue forest spirit glowing beneath flower-twined brambles and teal mushrooms in Whispering Forest
storyParts.imageAltZh: 低語森林裡發光的青色蘑菇與花藤拱門下，漂浮著溫柔發亮的森林精靈
paragraphsEn: With his gleaming IronSword at his waist and the faithful golden-tan puppy at his heels, Kai walked into the Whispering Forest—a twilight canopy of moss-draped trees, glowing mushrooms, and soft violet fireflies.

Whenever Kai asked a glowing mushroom or stone marker a question, they stayed completely silent. Suddenly, a luminous Forest Spirit drifted into the path like blue mist, blocking the tangled brambles.

"Travelers always talk AT me, never TO me," she sighed. Right beside Kai, the puppy let out a soft woof and nudged Kai's hand. True magic means pausing to listen! The Spirit taught Kai the Spell of Patience: input("What is your name? ").

The forest grew wonderfully still. A purple firefly box flickered in the air, waiting. Kai spoke softly into the quiet—and as the forest accepted his words, the loyal pup finally earned his true name: String! The brambles parted, and String bounded joyfully ahead.
paragraphsZh: 凱把閃亮的鐵劍別在腰間，帶著忠實的小黃狗走進暮色籠罩的「低語森林」。這裡長滿發光的蘑菇，紫色的螢火蟲在古樹苔蘚間飛舞。
奇怪的是，無論凱問路邊的蘑菇或石碑什麼問題，誰都不回答他。突然，一位散發藍光的森林精靈飄浮出來，擋住了滿是荊棘的小路。
「旅人總是自顧自地說話，從來不聽我回答。」精靈輕嘆。身旁的小狗輕輕叫了一聲，用鼻尖頂了頂凱的手心。原來真正的魔法需要耐心傾聽！精靈教凱唸出傾聽咒：input("What is your name? ")。
森林瞬間安靜下來，空中浮現一個像螢火蟲般閃爍的紫色輸入框，靜靜等待回答。凱溫柔地說出名字，森林接納了他們，小狗也終於擁有了屬於自己的名字——「String（字串）」！荊棘分開，String 開心地往前奔跑。

dialogue.lineEn: "To pass through my woods, you must pause, ask your question, and wait for the world to answer."
dialogue.lineZh: 「想穿過這座森林，你必須先停下來、提出問題，並耐心等待世界的回應。」

dialogue.lineEn: "Your name is String! Come on, String, let's go together!"
dialogue.lineZh: 「你的名字就叫 String 吧！走吧，String，我們一起出發！」

scenes.titleZh: 低語森林裡無人回應的呼喊
scenes.narrationEn: In the Whispering Forest, shadows danced and leaves rustled with secrets. Yet every time Kai called out to a glowing mushroom or stone marker, they stayed silent, ignoring him completely.
scenes.narrationZh: 在低語森林裡，葉片沙沙作響。但每當凱向發光蘑菇或古老石碑提問時，它們卻始終保持沉默，完全不理會他。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Hello?! Why won't anyone answer?"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「喂？！為什麼大家都不回答我？」
scenes.spellCode: # Talking AT the world yields silence
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 4. LISTEN — The Whispering Forest (Pause & Listen = input())
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 四、LISTEN 傾聽咒 — 低語森林（停下傾聽：input()）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Kai and the pup stepped beneath the twilight canopy of the Whispering Forest—a realm where dancing shadows drifted over ancient moss and every leaf rustled with quiet secrets.

Yet as Kai walked deeper into the gloom, something troubled him deeply: every time he called out a question to a glowing mushroom or a mossy stone marker, they stayed coldly silent, ignoring his spells entirely.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
一人一狗踏入「低語森林」的暮色樹冠下——這裡的影子隨著枝葉輕舞，彷彿每片葉子都藏著未說出口的祕密。

但越往深處走，凱心裡越覺得不對勁：無論他向發光的蘑菇或古老石碑提出什麼問題，對方都毫無反應，完全把他單方面施放的咒語當成耳邊風。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Hello? Glowing mushroom? Ancient marker? Why won't anything answer me back?"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「請問有人嗎？發光蘑菇？古老石碑？為什麼大家都不理會我的問題呢？」

scenes.titleEn: The Forest Spirit & The Pup's Gentle Nudge
scenes.titleZh: 森林精靈與小狗的溫柔提醒
scenes.narrationEn: "Travelers always talk AT me, never TO me," sighed a luminous Forest Spirit blocking the trail. Beside Kai, the pup let out a soft woof and nudged his hand, reminding him to pause and listen.
scenes.narrationZh: 「旅人總是只對我說話，卻從不聽我回答。」發光的森林精靈擋住小路嘆息道。小黃狗輕輕叫了一聲並用鼻子頂頂凱的手心，提醒他靜下心傾聽。
scenes.dialogueEn: Forest Spirit: "Pause, ask, and wait for the world to answer."
scenes.dialogueZh: 森林精靈：「停下來提問，然後耐心等待世界的回應。」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
"Travelers always talk at me, never to me," sighed a luminous Forest Spirit, materializing like a wisp of cool blue mist across the twisting trail. "You cast your spells into the wind, young wizard, but you never stop to listen for a reply."

Right beside Kai, the golden-tan pup let out a soft woof and gently nudged Kai's hand—reminding him that true magic always requires patience and two-way connection.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
「旅人們總是只顧著對森林說話，卻從來不聽森林回答。」一縷如湛藍薄霧般的森林精靈在蜿蜒小徑上顯現身形，輕聲嘆息：「年輕的法師啊，你把咒語丟進風裡，卻從沒停下來傾聽回音。」

就在此刻，身旁的小黃狗發出一聲溫柔的輕吠，用鼻子輕輕頂了頂凱的手心——提醒著凱，真正的魔法需要耐心與雙向的交流。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Forest Spirit: "To pass through my woods, you must pause, ask your question, and wait for the world to answer."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 森林精靈：「想穿過我的森林，你必須先停下腳步、提出問題，並安靜等待世界給你的回答。」

Tapping her mossy staff against the earth, the Forest Spirit taught Kai the spell of patient listening: input("What is your name? ").

At once, the forest grew wonderfully still. A glowing purple input box flickered on the twilight air like a gentle firefly, waiting patiently. Kai spoke calmly into the quiet and listened with all his heart—and as the forest accepted his words, his loyal golden-tan pup finally earned his true name: String!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
森林精靈將魔杖輕點在青苔地上，傳授給凱象徵耐心傾聽的咒語：input("What is your name? ")。

霎時間，整座森林安靜得連露水滴落都聽得見。一道紫色微光的輸入對話框像螢火蟲般在空中靜靜閃爍等待。凱平心靜氣地唸出名字、也專心聆聽小狗的心意——就在森林接納回答的那一刻，這隻忠誠的小黃狗終於擁有了自己的名字：String（字串）！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "input('What is your name? ') — Wait... you heard us! Your true name is String!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「input('What is your name? ') ——太棒了！森林聽見了，從今天起你的名字就叫 String！」

scenes.titleZh: 荊棘分開與歡快前行
scenes.narrationEn: The tangled brambles parted wide to reveal the secret path ahead, and Kai and String bounded joyfully down the newly opened trail!
scenes.narrationZh: 糾結的荊棘向兩旁分開，露出一條明亮的祕密小徑，凱與剛剛得到名字的 String 開心地奔向前方！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Come on, String!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「我們走吧，String！」

The dense wall of tangled emerald brambles parted smoothly to reveal a clear, lantern-lit forest exit ahead.

String bounded joyfully down the newly opened trail beside Kai, both of them stepping out into the cool evening breeze filled with the soothing sound of rushing river water.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
原本糾纏密布的翠綠荊棘緩緩向左右分開，露出一條清澈明亮的森林大道。

剛得到新名字的 String 開心地沿著小路向前奔躍，帶著凱一起走出幽暗森林，迎面吹來清涼的晚風與遠方潺潺流動的水聲。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: String: "Woof!" · Kai: "Look, String—the brambles opened! Let's follow the sound of the river!"

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Deep inside the twilight Whispering Forest, glowing mushrooms and carved stone markers ignored Kai's one-sided questions—until a luminous blue Forest Spirit and a gentle nudge from the pup reminded Kai to slow down and truly listen.

Casting input("What is your name? ") sparked a patient purple firefly box in the air; as Kai listened and responded with care, the loyal golden-tan pup earned his true name—String!—and the tangled brambles parted wide.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 走進低語森林後，無論凱怎麼單方面問話，發光蘑菇與石碑全都沉默不語。直到湛藍的森林精靈現身點醒，加上小黃狗輕碰手心提醒他耐心傾聽。
唸出 input("What is your name? ") 後，空中閃起紫色光框靜靜等候回應。凱真誠回答並聆聽小狗心聲的那一刻，小黃狗終於獲得真名「String」，糾纏荊棘也應聲讓路！
