storyParts.imageAltEn: Sparkling riverbank and silver-leafed tree beside glowing ruby, sapphire, and golden treasure chests
storyParts.imageAltZh: 閃爍星光的河畔與銀葉大樹旁，閃耀著紅寶石、藍寶石與黃金三個魔法寶箱
paragraphsEn: Beyond the parted brambles, Kai and String happily reunited with the Great Wizard! Together they walked to the grey pebbles of the Cursed Riverbank, where thousands of golden coins glittered in the sand.

Eagerly, Kai scooped up a handful of coins—POOF! They turned into grey dust and blew away! The Wizard warned that any unnamed treasure disappears into the river's curse unless it is locked inside a named Vault using the Equals Padlock =.
Kai slammed a wooden chest shut and spun the lock: gold = 100, then checked inside with print(gold). CLACK! All 100 coins stayed shining safely inside, with String sitting proudly on top as guard!

Then the Great Wizard pulled out a shimmering silver pouch—a Spatial Dimensional Pocket! With a swirl of warm gold light, the heavy chest shrank right into Kai's belt so they could travel light toward the mountain foothills.
paragraphsZh: 走出荊棘後，凱和 String 開心地與大法師重逢！他們一起來到布滿灰色鵝卵石的「詛咒河畔」，岸邊閃耀著成千上萬枚金幣。
凱興奮地抓起一把金幣——噗的一聲！金幣全化成了灰塵飛走！大法師提醒他：沒有被取名保護的寶藏會被河水的詛咒吹散，必須用「等號大鎖 =」鎖進有名字的保險箱裡。
凱用力關上木箱並轉動大鎖：gold = 100，接著用 print(gold) 檢查裡面。喀嚓！一百枚金幣閃閃發亮地安全躺在裡面，String 還驕傲地坐在箱子上當警衛！
大法師隨後取出一個銀色發光小袋子——「空間百寶袋」！笨重的木箱化成溫暖金光收進凱腰間的袋子裡，讓他們能輕裝出發前往山谷。

dialogue.lineEn: "Lock it inside a named Vault with =! Travel light, apprentice."
dialogue.lineZh: 「用等號 = 把它鎖進有名字的保險箱裡！輕裝前進吧，我的學徒。」

spell.nameZh: 第五咒：VAULT 儲存魔法 — 等號 (=)
spell.explainEn: The single equals sign = stores a value inside a labeled variable name so nothing gets lost.
spell.explainZh: 一個等號 = 就像大鎖，把右邊的寶藏穩穩鎖進左邊的變數名字裡，再也不會不見！
spell.demoOutputEn: CLACK! gold = 100 stored safely -> print(gold) outputs: 100
spell.demoOutputZh: 喀嚓！gold = 100 已安全鎖好 -> print(gold) 顯示：100

scenes.titleZh: 重逢大法師與消失的金幣
scenes.narrationEn: Reuniting with the Great Wizard, Kai and String reached the barren Cursed Riverbank. Thousands of gold coins glittered on the pebbles—but the moment Kai scooped a handful, POOF! Every coin vanished into grey dust!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱與 String 再次與大法師會合，來到光禿禿的詛咒河畔。卵石上閃耀著無數金幣，但凱才剛抓起一把——噗！金幣竟在指縫間化成灰煙消失了！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Hey! Where did all the gold go?!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「咦！金幣怎麼全都不見了？！」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 5. VAULT — The Cursed Riverbank (Equals Sign = Padlock = =)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 五、VAULT 寶庫咒 — 受詛咒的河岸（等號鎖：=）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Waiting calmly along the scenic highway stood the Great Wizard, adjusting his starry blue cloak with a proud smile. Marching together toward the Bug King's distant dark mountain, lush green grass suddenly gave way to barren grey stones at the Cursed Riverbank.

Across the smooth pebbles glittered thousands of golden coins shining like fallen stars! Eagerly, Kai scooped up a huge double handful—POOF! In a puff of grey dust, every coin vanished right out of his fingers!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
在林外的景觀大道旁，大法師早已披著星辰藍披風微笑等候。一人一狗與大法師重新會合，並肩朝黑山前進；可走著走著，綠油油的草地卻變成了荒涼灰石，來到了令人不安的「受詛咒河岸」。

圓潤的河畔鵝卵石上閃耀著成千上萬枚金幣，宛如墜落的星辰。凱興奮地雙手掬起滿滿一把金幣——「噗！」一陣灰色塵霧飄散，指縫裡的金幣竟在一眨眼間全數消失得無影無蹤！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Wait—every single coin just vanished into grey dust right out of my fingers!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「咦——金幣剛拿到手裡，怎麼就變成一陣灰塵憑空消失了！？」

scenes.titleZh: 木箱與等號大鎖 (=)
scenes.narrationEn: "Any treasure left unnamed disappears into the river's curse," the Wizard warned. "Lock it inside a named Vault using the Equals Padlock =!"
scenes.narrationZh: 大法師提醒道：「沒有名字保護的寶物都會被河水詛咒奪走。你必須用『等號大鎖 =』把它鎖進有名字的保險箱裡！」
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Lock it inside a named Vault with =!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「用等號大鎖 = 把它鎖進專屬的保險箱吧！」
scenes.spellCode: # Lock value into a named variable
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
"Any treasure left unnamed disappears into the river's curse," the Great Wizard warned, pointing his glowing staff toward a sturdy, empty wooden chest resting on the grey stones.

"In Pythonia, you cannot just hold wealth loose in your hands—you must lock it inside a named Vault using the Equals Padlock =!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
「任何沒有被取名鎖好的財富，都會被河岸的詛咒吞噬。」大法師舉起魔杖指向岸邊一只厚實卻空蕩蕩的木頭寶箱，鄭重提醒道：

「在蟒蛇王國裡，你不能只用手握著數值——你必須用『等號鎖 =』，把它安全鎖進有名字的寶庫變數裡！」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "You must lock it inside a named Vault using the Equals Padlock =!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「你必須運用『等號鎖 =』，把寶物穩穩鎖進屬於它名字的寶庫裡！」

scenes.titleZh: 鎖住 gold = 100 與小守衛 String
scenes.narrationEn: Kai spun the lock—gold = 100—and checked inside with print(gold). CLACK! All 100 coins shone safely inside, with String sitting proudly on top as guard!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱轉動大鎖寫下 gold = 100，再用 print(gold) 查看——喀嚓！一百枚金幣安穩地閃閃發光，String 驕傲地坐在箱子頂端當起了小小守衛！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "gold = 100! Safe and sound!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「gold = 100！全都安穩鎖好囉！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Kai slammed the heavy wooden chest shut and spun the glowing rune padlock—gold = 100—securing his treasure safely inside the named Vault. Eager to verify that the magic held, he raised his Spellbook and cast: print(gold).

CLACK! The lid shone with steady golden light, and all 100 coins gleamed safely inside—with loyal String sitting proudly on top as guard!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱用力蓋上沉重的木箱，轉動閃耀金光的等號寶鎖——gold = 100——把一百枚金幣穩穩封存進名為 gold 的寶庫裡。為了確認魔法生效，他舉起咒語書朗聲唸道：print(gold)。

「喀噠！」一聲清脆，箱蓋綻放出穩定柔和的金光，裡頭整整一百枚金幣安然閃亮——而忠心的小狗 String 正威風凜凜地坐在箱蓋上負責看守！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "gold = 100 ... print(gold)! Look, String—all 100 coins stayed right where we locked them!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「gold = 100 …… print(gold)！快看 String，整整一百枚金幣全都安安全全地鎖住了！」

scenes.titleEn: The Spatial Dimensional Pocket & Foothill March
scenes.titleZh: 空間百寶袋與山麓行軍
scenes.narrationEn: Seeing Kai's amazement, the Great Wizard gifted him a shimmering silver Spatial Dimensional Pocket. The heavy chest shrank into warm golden light flowing right into Kai's belt as they marched toward the mountains!
scenes.narrationZh: 大法師從袍中拿出閃亮的銀色「空間百寶袋」送給凱。沉重的木箱瞬間化作一道暖金光流收進凱的腰帶裡，三人一起朝高山邁進！
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Travel light, apprentice!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「輕裝前行吧，小法師！」
scenes.spellCode: # Chest stored in Spatial Dimensional Pocket
scenes.advanceSectionEn: The Spatial Dimensional Pocket & Journey to the Echoing Cavern
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 篇章插曲：空間百寶袋與前往迴音洞窟的旅程
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Seeing Kai's amazement, the Great Wizard pulled a shimmering silver pouch from his robes: a Spatial Dimensional Pocket. "A true wizard of Pythonia cannot carry heavy wooden chests across the realm," he laughed. Watchful String tilted his head as the heavy wooden chest shrank gently into golden light streaming straight into Kai's belt!

With his vault carried weightlessly at his waist, Kai, String, and the Wizard resumed their march. String bounded ahead chasing luminous river-butterflies until rugged stone cliffs rose in deep purple twilight—leading straight to a shadowy fissure at the mountain base: the entrance to the echoing cavern.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
看見凱驚喜的神情，大法師微笑著從袍中取出一只閃爍銀光的錦囊——「空間百寶袋」。「真正的法師總不能扛著厚重木箱走遍天下吧。」在 String 好奇歪頭的注視下，大木箱化作一束溫暖金光縮小飛入凱的腰帶！

身上輕巧無比、寶物卻隨時都在，一人一狗跟著大法師再次上路。String 一路追逐著灑落星塵的發光河蝶，直到暮色紫霧湧上山崖，引領他們來到山腳下一道幽深神祕的巨大岩縫——迴音洞窟的入口。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "This Spatial Dimensional Pocket holds your Vault—now let us enter the echoing cavern."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「這個空間百寶袋能為你收好寶庫——現在，我們一起走進前方的迴音洞窟吧。」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Reunited with the Great Wizard on the barren Cursed Riverbank, Kai watched loose handfuls of golden coins vanish in puffs of dust (POOF!) until he locked them inside a sturdy chest with the Equals Padlock: gold = 100 and print(gold).

To spare Kai heavy burdens, the Wizard gifted a shimmering silver Spatial Dimensional Pocket that shrank the entire gold vault onto Kai's belt—and with String chasing glowing river-butterflies ahead, they marched into the twilight mountain fissure toward the echoing cavern.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 在受詛咒河岸與大法師重逢後，凱親眼看見抓在手心卻沒取名的金幣瞬間化為灰霧消失，直到學會用等號鎖鎖定「gold = 100」才順利守住一百枚金幣。
大法師接著贈予「空間百寶袋」，將沉重木箱縮小收進凱的腰帶！一路上 String 快樂追逐發光河蝶，陪伴凱與導師走進山腳下的迴音洞窟。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 6: MULTI-VAULT — Three Chests & the Wizard's Farewell
storyParts.titleZh: 第六章：MULTI-VAULT 多重寶箱 — 齊心鎖寶與大法師告別
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 6: hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10 · Lock many vaults at once
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第六咒：hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10 · 一口氣鎖好三個寶箱
storyParts.imageAltEn: Crystal cavern altar holding ruby HP chest, golden Gold chest, and sapphire Mana chest beside the silver-leafed tree
storyParts.imageAltZh: 迴音山洞裡的三座寶箱祭壇，紅、金、藍三色寶箱與洞外的銀葉樹相映
paragraphsEn: At twilight, Kai, String, and the Great Wizard stepped into an echoing mountain cavern. On a stone altar sat three glowing chests: ruby-red for HP, sapphire-blue for Mana, and bright gold for Gold.

HISSSS! A creeping red shadow darted from the dark rocks to snatch the treasures away! There wasn't time to lock them one by one. While String barked bravely to distract the shadow, Kai lined all three up in one breath: hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10!
CLACK-CLACK-CLACK! Three heavy iron padlocks slammed shut at the exact same moment, pulling all three vital stats safely into Kai's Spatial Dimensional Pocket.

Stepping outside beneath a silver-leafed tree, the Great Wizard placed a gentle hand on Kai's shoulder. "From here on, trust your own mind," he smiled. With a flash of emerald starlight, the Wizard dissolved into glowing code, leaving Kai and String standing bravely together on the mountain trail.
paragraphsZh: 暮色降臨時，凱、String 與大法師走進迴音山洞。石祭壇上擺著三個發光寶箱：紅寶石箱裝著生命值（HP）、藍寶石箱裝著魔力（Mana）、金箱裝著金幣（Gold）。
嘶——！一道紅色暗影突然從黑暗中撲出想搶走寶物！沒時間一個一個上鎖了！String 勇敢地大叫吸引暗影注意，凱深吸一口氣同時對準三個箱子施咒：hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10！
喀嚓、喀嚓、喀嚓！三把大鎖同時緊緊扣上，三份重要力量瞬間飛進空間百寶袋。
走出洞外，他們在一棵銀葉大樹下停步。大法師輕拍凱的肩膀微笑說：「接下來，你必須相信自己的智慧，勇敢走下去。」說完，大法師化為漫天翠綠星光般的文字消散，留下凱與 String 勇敢邁步。

dialogue.lineEn: "You have mastered all the foundational spells I know. May your code always compile true."
dialogue.lineZh: 「你已經學會我所知道的基礎魔法了。願你的程式碼永遠真誠且運行無礙。」

spell.nameZh: 第六咒：MULTI-VAULT 多重儲存魔法
spell.explainEn: Use commas on both sides of = to assign multiple variables cleanly in one single line!
spell.explainZh: 在等號兩邊都用逗號排好順序，就能在同一個瞬間一次儲存好幾個數值！
spell.demoOutputZh: 喀嚓三連響！HP = 100 · Mana = 50 · Gold = 10 全部鎖好！

scenes.titleEn: The Stone Altar of Three Chests
scenes.titleZh: 迴音洞窟的三寶箱祭壇
scenes.narrationEn: At twilight, they entered the echoing cavern and found three glowing chests on a raised stone altar: a ruby-red chest for HP, a sapphire-blue chest for Mana, and a gleaming chest for Gold.
scenes.narrationZh: 黃昏時，他們走進迴音洞窟，發現石祭壇上放著三個發光寶箱：紅寶石生命箱（HP）、藍寶石魔力箱（Mana）與閃亮金幣箱（Gold）。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Three glowing chests at once!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「一次有三個發光寶箱！」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 6. MULTI-VAULT — The Cave of Three Chests (Names, Names = Values, Values)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 六、MULTI-VAULT 多重寶庫咒 — 三寶箱洞窟
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Inside the damp, crystal-lit cavern, glowing subterranean quartz reflected across shimmering underground pools.

Upon a raised stone altar ahead stood three radiant chests waiting together: a ruby-red chest for HP (health), a sapphire-blue chest for Mana (magic energy), and a gleaming golden chest for Gold.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
走進微涼潮濕、閃耀著天然水晶光輝的洞窟深處，地下泉水映出斑斕光影。

就在前方高起的石祭壇上，並列著三只發光的魔法寶箱：象徵生命值的紅寶石箱 HP、象徵魔力的藍寶石箱 Mana，以及金光閃閃的金幣箱 Gold。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Three glowing chests at once—ruby HP, sapphire Mana, and gleaming Gold!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「石壇上同時有三只發光寶箱——紅色的 HP、藍色的 Mana，還有閃亮的 Gold！」

scenes.titleEn: The Creeping Red Shadow & String's Bark
scenes.titleZh: 紅影來襲與 String 勇敢吠叫
scenes.narrationEn: Suddenly, a creeping red shadow hissed from the darkness to snatch the chests! "There's no time to lock them one by one!" shouted the Wizard as String barked bravely to hold the shadow back.
scenes.narrationZh: 突然，一道詭異的紅影從黑暗中竄出想搶走寶物！「來不及一個一個鎖了！」大法師大喊，String 則勇敢地大聲吠叫替凱拖延時間！
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "Line them up all at once, apprentice!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「同時排成一列，一口氣全部鎖起來！」
scenes.spellCode: # No time to lock one by one!
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Suddenly, a creeping red shadow hissed out from the cave darkness, darting fast across the stone floor to swallow all three treasures before Kai could touch them!

"There's no time to lock them one by one—the shadow is far too fast!" the Great Wizard shouted, bracing his glowing staff to hold back the advancing gloom. "Line them up all at once, apprentice!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
突然間，洞穴陰影裡竄出一道嘶嘶作響的猩紅黑影，貼著冰冷石面飛快撲來，想一口吞掉三箱能量！

「沒時間一個一個慢慢上鎖了——那團黑影速度太快！」大法師高舉藍水晶法杖抵擋逼近的黑暗，大聲喊道：「把它們排成一列，一口氣全部同時上鎖！」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "There's no time to lock them one by one—line them up all at once, apprentice!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「來不及單獨上鎖了——小魔法師，一口氣把三個名字和數值整齊對齊！」

scenes.titleZh: 三重齊鎖：hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10
scenes.narrationEn: In a single breath, Kai cast: hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10. CLACK-CLACK-CLACK! Three iron padlocks slammed shut at once, sealing all three vital stats safely into his Spatial Pocket!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱屏氣凝神一氣呵成唸出：hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10！喀嚓、喀嚓、喀嚓！三個鐵鎖同時合上，三份珍貴數值安全飛進空間百寶袋！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
With brave String barking fiercely to distract the creeping shadow, Kai raised his Spellbook, aligned all three Vault names and treasures side by side, and cast in one steady breath: hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10.

CLACK-CLACK-CLACK! Three heavy iron padlocks slammed shut at the exact same instant! A brilliant barrier of blue and gold light froze the red shadow in its tracks and zipped all three vital stats safely into Kai's Spatial Dimensional Pocket!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
勇敢的 String 朝黑影大聲狂吠分散注意，凱趁勢舉起咒語書，將三個名字與三個數值整齊並排，屏息一唸：hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10。

「喀噠、喀噠、喀噠！」三把厚重鐵鎖在同一個瞬間同時鎖死！藍與金交織的絢麗光牆猛然綻放，當場震退猩紅黑影，並把三股珍貴力量平安收進凱的空間百寶袋！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10 — Triple lock complete!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10 ——三重鎖定同時完成！」

scenes.titleZh: 銀葉樹下大法師的翠綠告別
scenes.narrationEn: Outside beneath a sprawling silver-leafed tree, the Great Wizard placed a gentle hand on Kai's shoulder. "From here on, trust your own mind. May your code always compile true." In a swirl of emerald starlight, he dissolved into the code.
scenes.narrationZh: 走出洞窟來到一棵銀葉大樹下，大法師輕輕拍了拍凱的肩膀：「接下來的路要相信自己的心智。願你的程式碼永遠順利編譯。」隨即化為翠綠星光與數字符號消散在夜空。
scenes.dialogueEn: Great Wizard: "May your code always compile true."
scenes.dialogueZh: 大法師：「願你的程式碼永遠真誠無誤。」
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 篇章插曲：大法師的道別
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Stepping out of the cavern onto a high mountain trail at dusk, the Great Wizard paused beneath a sprawling silver-leafed tree and checked the glowing crests along Kai's belt with a proud smile. "You have mastered Voice, Weave, Fuse, Listen, Vaults, and Multi-Vaults. From this moment on, you must depend entirely on yourself and trust your own mind."

Kai felt a flutter of nerves, until warm String pressed firmly against his leg with a brave bark. Whispering "May your code always compile true," the Wizard dissolved in a sudden flash of emerald starlight, leaving Kai and String standing ready together.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
走出迴音洞窟時已近黃昏，一行人沿著山道向上攀登。大法師停在一棵枝葉繁茂的銀葉大樹下，欣慰地望著凱腰帶上閃閃發亮的魔法徽章：「我已把我所知的基礎善咒全都傳授給你了。從這一刻起，你必須完全相信自己的頭腦，靠自己的力量走下去。」

凱的心微微緊張地顫動了一下，但溫暖的 String 立刻緊緊靠著他的腿邊，發出一聲沉穩勇敢的吠叫。大法師柔聲道別：「願你的程式碼永遠正確編譯。」說完，他在一陣燦爛的翠綠星光中化為漂浮的數位光字消散，留下凱與 String 並肩面向前方的山嶺。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Great Wizard: "You are ready, young apprentice. May your code always compile true."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 大法師：「你已經準備好了，年輕的法師。願你的程式碼永遠正確無誤地運行。」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Inside the crystal cavern, a hissing red shadow lunged to snatch all three glowing chests—until String barked bravely and Kai locked all three vital stats at once: hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10 (CLACK-CLACK-CLACK!).

On the twilight ridge beneath a silver-leafed tree, the Great Wizard declared Kai ready to trust his own mind—whispering "May your code always compile true" before dissolving into radiant emerald starlight.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 洞窟內猩紅黑影來勢洶洶，凱在 String 勇敢吠叫掩護下，排出三重寶庫鎖「hp, mana, gold = 100, 50, 10」，一瞬間同時鎖住生命、魔力與金幣並退敵！
離開洞窟後的銀葉樹下，大法師欣慰地告訴凱從此要學會獨立判斷，留下祝福后化作漫天翠綠星光消散在夜空裡。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 7: WHISPER — The Sleeping Dragon's Library
storyParts.titleZh: 第七章：WHISPER 悄悄話咒 — 睡龍古書庫的默契
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 7: # Secret human note · Leave helpful notes that magic ignores
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第七咒：# 靜音記號 · 魔法不會聽見的人類悄悄話
storyParts.imageAltEn: Quiet ancient threshold guarded by gentle woodland light where Kai and String tiptoe silently
storyParts.imageAltZh: 寧靜的古老森林書庫入口，凱與 String 躡手躡腳安靜穿行
paragraphsEn: High along the mountain cliff, Kai and String arrived at towering bronze doors. Curled right across the doorway was a gigantic red dragon, fast asleep with tiny curls of smoke drifting from her nose!

If Kai cast a normal spell, the loud magic sparks would surely wake the dragon. Just then, the translucent Ghost Librarian drifted through the door holding a glowing silver feather quill to her lips: "Shhh!"

She explained that wizards often need to leave clear notes for humans to read—without making Pythonia's magic run out loud. With a gentle stroke of her quill, she traced a shimmering # Mute Mark onto Kai's cheek.

Kai raised his Spellbook and quietly typed a whispered note: # I am going inside the library. Because of #, Pythonia ignored the line completely! The red dragon kept snoring peacefully while Kai and String tiptoed safely inside.
paragraphsZh: 沿著山壁小路，凱和 String 來到一扇巨大的青銅門前。門檻上正盤踞著一頭正在打呼的巨大紅龍，鼻孔還冒著一縷縷小煙！
如果施展普通咒語，響亮的魔法火花一定會吵醒紅龍。這時，戴著眼鏡的透明幽靈圖書管理員飄出門縫，將發光的銀羽毛筆貼在嘴唇前：「噓——！」
她告訴凱，法師們常需要寫下給人類看的筆記，但又不能讓王國的魔法引擎把它當成指令執行。她輕輕用羽毛筆在凱臉頰上畫了一個閃亮的井字靜音符號「#」。
凱在咒語書裡安靜寫下：# I am going inside the library. 因為開頭有「#」，魔法系統完全忽略了這行悄悄話！紅龍繼續香甜沉睡，凱和 String 順利溜進了古書庫。

dialogue.lineEn: "Shhh! Humans need to leave notes for each other, but the magic must never hear them. Use the Mute Mark #!"
dialogue.lineZh: 「噓！人類需要互相留筆記，但不能讓魔法聽見。只要在最前面加上靜音記號 # 就行了！」

spell.nameZh: 第七咒：WHISPER 靜音筆記 — 井字號 (#)
spell.code: # I am going inside the library.
spell.explainEn: Anything written after # on a line is a comment—it helps human readers understand code, and Python skips it silently.
spell.explainZh: 寫在「#」後面的文字叫做註解，是給人類夥伴看的小筆記，電腦會安安靜靜跳過它不執行。
spell.demoOutputEn: (Silence... zzz... 🐉 The dragon sleeps on while your # note stays hidden!)
spell.demoOutputZh: （一片安靜……呼嚕嚕……🐉 紅龍繼續熟睡，只有人類看得見 # 筆記！）

scenes.titleEn: The Giant Red Dragon at the Bronze Doors
scenes.titleZh: 青銅大門前沉睡的巨紅龍
scenes.narrationEn: The mountain trail brought Kai and String to massive bronze doors guarded by a gigantic crimson dragon curled fast asleep across the threshold.
scenes.narrationZh: 山路帶著凱與 String 來到巍峨的青銅圖書館大門前，一隻巨大的紅龍正盤踞在門檻上呼呼大睡。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Real code magic will wake her up!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「如果施展真正的魔法，一定會吵醒牠！」
scenes.spellCode: # Careful not to wake the dragon
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 7. WHISPER — The Sleeping Dragon's Library (# = Mute the Line = Comment)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 七、WHISPER 低語咒 — 沉睡巨龍的圖書館（靜音符號：#）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
The winding mountain path led Kai and String past towering stone pillars straight to a massive pair of ancient bronze library doors.

Curled fast asleep right across the stone threshold lay a gigantic red dragon—her ruby-bright scales gleaming in the twilight as deep, heavy rumbles rose and fell from her chest.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
蜿蜒山路帶著凱和 String 穿過高聳的古石柱群，來到一扇氣勢磅礴的青銅圖書館大門前。

然而就在青銅門檻正前方，一頭身軀龐大如小山的紅龍正蜷曲沉睡著——她宛如紅寶石般的鱗片在暮色中閃閃發亮，胸口每呼吸一次都傳出低沉的轟鳴。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai (whispering): "Step carefully, String... one loud spark from my Spellbook could wake that dragon!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱（氣音小聲）：「腳步放輕，String……要是不小心觸發吵鬧的魔法火花，這頭巨龍一定會醒過來！」

scenes.titleZh: 幽靈圖書館員的 # 靜音印記
scenes.narrationEn: Out drifted the translucent Ghost Librarian, holding a glowing feather quill to her lips. "Shhh! Magic must never hear human notes. Use the Mute Mark #!" She traced a shimmering # right onto Kai's cheek.
scenes.narrationZh: 透明的幽靈圖書館員飄了出來，將發光的羽毛筆豎在嘴唇前輕聲說：「噓！人類留下的筆記不能讓魔法聽見，要用靜音記號 #！」說完在凱的臉頰畫上發光的 # 符號。
scenes.dialogueEn: Ghost Librarian: "Shhh! Use the Mute Mark #!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 幽靈圖書館員：「噓！用靜音符號 # 就不會驚動魔法！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Drifting softly out from the doorway shadows appeared the Ghost Librarian in flowing robes, pressing a glowing feather quill to her lips. "Shhh!" she whispered. "Humans need to leave notes for each other, but the Pythonia magic must never hear them. Use the Mute Mark #—a secret whisper only humans read and the magic completely ignores!"

With a delicate stroke of her glowing quill, she traced a shimmering # mark right onto Kai's cheek.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
大門陰影中輕輕飄出一位身披飄逸長袍的「幽靈圖書館員」，她將散發柔和微光的羽毛筆輕抵唇前：「噓——！」她輕聲細語道：「人類需要彼此寫筆記交流，但不能讓蟒蛇王國的魔法聽見或執行！用靜音符號 # ——那是只有人類看得見、魔法系統卻會完全忽略的祕密悄悄話！」

她伸出羽毛筆尖，溫柔地在凱的臉頰上輕輕畫下一枚發著微光的「#」印記。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Ghost Librarian: "Shhh! Use the Mute Mark #—a whisper only humans read and the magic ignores!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 幽靈圖書館員：「噓——！用靜音符號 # ，讓這句話只給人類閱讀，魔法會完全保持安靜。」

scenes.titleEn: Typing the Silent Note: # I am going inside the library.
scenes.titleZh: 寫下靜音筆記：# I am going inside the library.
scenes.narrationEn: Kai raised his Spellbook and typed a quiet, muted note into the air: # I am going inside the library. Pythonia's loud magic ignored it completely!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱輕手輕腳舉起咒語書，在空中寫下一行不會觸發魔法的悄悄話：# I am going inside the library. 魔法果然完全沒有響起！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai (whispering): "# I am going inside the library."
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱（低聲）：「# 我正要走進圖書館。」
scenes.spellCode: Spell: # I am going inside the library.
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Stepping gingerly past the giant dragon's twitching crimson tail, Kai raised his Spellbook, held his breath, and quietly traced a silent note into the air:

# I am going inside the library.

Because the Mute Mark # silenced the entire line for Pythonia's magic engine, not a single spark cracked or hummed through the quiet dusk!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱屏住呼吸，躡手躡腳地繞過巨龍微微抽動的赤紅長尾，抬起《古老咒語書》，安靜地在空氣中寫下一行給自己看的小紙條：

# I am going inside the library.

由於句首的靜音號 # 讓整行文字在魔法眼中完全靜音，四周沒有迸出一丁點火花或聲響！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai (silently): "# I am going inside the library."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱（無聲書寫）：「# I am going inside the library.（＃我要走進圖書館了）」

scenes.titleZh: 星光古書庫與秘密旋轉階梯
scenes.narrationEn: The dragon snored peacefully on as Kai and String tiptoed safely inside the starlit Ancient Library—discovering a hidden spiral staircase behind the reading desk!
scenes.narrationZh: 巨龍繼續安穩打呼，凱與 String 躡手躡腳安全溜進星光閃耀的古老圖書館——在書桌後方發現了一座通往地底的秘密旋轉階梯！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "Safe and sound, String! Look behind the desk!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「安全過關了，String！你看書桌後面！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
The giant red dragon snored peacefully on. With String tiptoeing quietly at his boots, Kai slipped through the bronze doors into the quiet, starlit hall of the Ancient Library.

Between towering shelves of floating leather tomes, String's keen nose began sniffing behind the oak reading desk—uncovering a hidden stone trapdoor glowing softly with prismatic crystal light!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
沉睡的紅寶石巨龍依然打著平穩的呼嚕，連眼皮也沒動一下。String 踮著小肉墊無聲跟隨，一人一狗順利滑進星光閃爍、萬籟俱寂的古老圖書館大廳。

就在一排排飄浮典籍的橡木書桌後方，靈敏的 String 用鼻子東聞西嗅——竟然在地板角落嗅出了一扇正透出七彩微光的隱藏地下暗門！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: String: "*sniff sniff*" · Kai: "Good find, String! Look—there's a glowing trapdoor hidden behind this desk!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: String：「（用力嗅聞）」· 小英雄凱：「好樣的 String！你看——書桌後面藏著一道發光的地下活板門！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Finding a gigantic ruby-scaled red dragon curled fast asleep across the Ancient Library doors, Kai learned the Whisper spell from the drifting Ghost Librarian, who traced a glowing # mark onto his cheek.

Typing a silent # human note let Kai and tiptoeing String slip peacefully past the snoring dragon into the starlit hall—where String's keen nose uncovered a prismatic hidden trapdoor behind the reading desk!
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 圖書館青銅大門前躺著一頭沉睡的紅寶石巨龍！幸虧幽靈圖書館員輕聲指點，並在凱臉頰點上發光的「#」靜音符號。
寫下只給人類看、魔法卻會保持安靜的「# 筆記」後，一人一狗無聲穿過睡龍踏進大廳——而靈敏的 String 更在書桌後方嗅出了一道透著彩光的地下秘門！

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 8: SHAPESHIFT — Four Spirits & Sunnybrook Village
storyParts.titleZh: 第八章：SHAPESHIFT 形變咒 — 水晶四精靈與晴溪村
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 8: type() · str, int, float, bool & Telepathic String
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第八咒：type() · 認識四種魔法形態並與晴溪村分享收成
storyParts.imageAltEn: Hero Kai overlooking bright Sunnybrook waterfalls and rainbow skies across the green mountain valley
storyParts.imageAltZh: 小英雄凱望著晴溪山谷壯麗的瀑布與彩虹，翠綠大地充滿希望
paragraphsEn: Behind the library desk, a hidden spiral staircase led deep underground into a sparkling Crystal Cave holding four Shapeshift Crystals: a Scroll for words (str), a Stone Golem for whole numbers (int), a Water Droplet for decimals (float), and a Flashing Gem for True/False (bool).

First, the golden str Scroll bonded right with String's collar—upgrading him so glowing ribbons of text could flash telepathically straight into Kai's Spellbook! Meanwhile, the chunky int Golem did energetic push-ups, the float Droplet bounced shimmering bubbles, and the bool Gem flashed green TRUE or red FALSE.

Climbing back up to Sunnybrook Village, they saw a fierce storm had knocked down houses and dried out crops. Working together, the int Golem lifted heavy logs to rebuild homes, and the float Droplet watered every thirsty field!

Suddenly String's new telepathic text flashed on Kai's Spellbook: "Kai! Someone is sneaking away with food sacks near the eastern shed!" The bool Gem flashed crimson "FALSE!" to expose a hungry little goblin's excuse—and instead of scolding him, Kai kindly shared a warm loaf from the restored harvest.
paragraphsZh: 書庫書桌後方藏著一座螺旋樓梯，通往地底閃耀的水晶洞窟，裡面住著四位形變水晶精靈：代表文字的捲軸精靈（str）、整數石頭人（int）、小數點水滴（float）以及判斷真假的閃耀寶石（bool）。
捲軸精靈 str 的光芒融進了 String 的項圈——讓他獲得與凱的咒語書心電感應、傳送發光文字的超能力！石頭人 int 開心地做起伏地挺身，水滴 float 彈跳著水珠，寶石 bool 則會閃出綠色的「TRUE」或紅色的「FALSE」。
爬出地面來到「晴溪村」，他們發現暴風雨剛吹倒了木屋、沖壞了農田。大家齊心合力，int 石頭人一口氣做了二十下伏地挺身並扛起大木頭重建家園，float 水滴仔細灌溉每一片農田！
突然，String 透過項圈傳來緊急文字：「凱！東邊穀倉有人偷抱走剩下的食物袋！」bool 寶石閃出紅光「FALSE！」揭穿了一隻飢餓小哥布林的藉口——但凱沒有生氣，反而溫柔地把重建好的收成分一半送給他。

dialogue.lineEn: "Kai! Someone is sneaking away with food sacks near the eastern shed!"
dialogue.lineZh: 「凱！東邊棚屋那裡有人正抱著剩下的食物袋偷溜！」

dialogue.lineEn: "True magic helps those in need. Let's share our harvest together."
dialogue.lineZh: 「真正的魔法是用來幫助需要的人。這份食物，我們一起分享吧。」

spell.nameZh: 第八咒：SHAPESHIFT 辨形魔法 — type()
spell.explainEn: type() acts like a magnifying glass to reveal whether data is text (str), whole number (int), decimal (float), or True/False (bool).
spell.explainZh: type() 就像魔法放大鏡，能看出資料是文字（str）、整數（int）、小數（float），還是是非對錯（bool）。

scenes.titleEn: Four Shapeshift Crystals & String's str Upgrade
scenes.titleZh: 四大水晶與 String 的心電感應升級
scenes.narrationEn: Deep underground, Kai and String found four glowing Shapeshift Crystals! The Scroll crystal (str) resonated straight with String—upgrading him with luminous text ribbons flowing directly into Kai's Spellbook!
scenes.narrationZh: 沿著階梯來到地底水晶洞窟，裡面飄浮著四顆形變水晶！其中代表文字的卷軸水晶（str）飛進了 String 身上——替他開啟了把文字直接傳進凱咒語書的心電感應連結！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "print(type('String'))! It's <class 'str'>!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print(type('String'))！是文字型態 <class 'str'>！」
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 八、SHAPESHIFT 變形咒 — 隱藏的水晶洞窟（分辨型態：type()）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Pulling open the iron ring, Kai and String descended a spiral stone staircase into a breathtaking underground cavern warmed by four floating Shapeshift Crystals.

When Kai approached the luminous Scroll Crystal (str for words), it resonated straight with his pup! String leaped joyfully into the crystal light and officially upgraded—now glowing ribbons of text flashed directly into Kai's Spellbook and mind in a secret telepathic bond!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
拉開鐵環掀開暗門，凱和 String 沿著螺旋石梯往下走，來到一座由四枚飄浮「變形水晶」照亮的奇幻地下水晶洞窟。

當凱走近象徵文字的卷軸水晶 str 時，水晶忽然與小狗產生了共鳴！String 開心地一躍而起吸納那束光影，正式完成升級——從此之後，發光的文字絲帶能透過心電感應，直接把 String 的心聲傳進凱的咒語書與腦海裡！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: String (telepathic str ribbon): "Kai! Look—I can finally send real words right into your Spellbook!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: String（心電感應文字光帶）：「凱！快看——我終於可以把真正的心裡話傳進你的咒語書裡了！」

scenes.titleEn: int Push-Ups, float Bubbles & bool Truth Gem
scenes.titleZh: 整數石像俯臥撐、浮點水滴與真假寶石
scenes.narrationEn: Around them, the Stone Block golem (int) dropped down to reel off energetic push-ups, the clear Water Droplet (float) bounced with shimmering decimal bubbles, and the Flashing Gem (bool) pulsed True and False!
scenes.narrationZh: 旁邊的整數小石像（int）立刻趴下做起精力充沛的伏地挺身，浮點小水滴（float）帶著小數點泡泡開心彈跳，布林寶石（bool）則閃耀著真假光芒！
scenes.dialogueEn: String (telepathic): "WHOA! LOOK AT INT GO!"
scenes.dialogueZh: String（心電感應文字）：「哇！你看整數小石像好有精神！」
scenes.spellCode: type(20) -> int | type(3.5) -> float | type(True) -> bool
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Beside newly telepathic String stood the three remaining spirit crystals waiting to reveal how every magical shape reveals itself under the type() magnifying glass:

The sturdy Stone Block golem (int for whole numbers), which immediately dropped down to do crisp push-ups; the clear Water Droplet (float for decimals), bouncing joyfully with shimmering bubbles; and the Flashing Gem (bool for True or False), a gleaming lie detector.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
在獲得文字天賦的 String 身旁，其餘三枚晶靈也一一顯現出在 type() 放大鏡下的真實樣貌：

結實穩重的石塊小巨人（int 整數）立刻趴在地上示範標準伏地挺身；晶瑩剔透的小水滴（float 小數）快樂地彈跳起舞，冒出串串七彩泡泡；還有一閃一閃的閃耀寶石（bool 真假布林值），是一顆絕不說謊的測謊晶石。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Four distinct shapes under type(): str for words, int for whole numbers, float for decimals, and bool for True/False!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「原來在 type() 下共有四種形狀：文字 str、整數 int、小數 float，還有真假 bool！」

scenes.titleZh: 重建晴溪村與抓包小哥布林
scenes.narrationEn: Climbing out to storm-damaged Sunnybrook Village, int hoisted fallen logs, float watered dry crops, String flashed a telepathic warning, and bool beamed crimson "FALSE!" to expose a hungry little goblin's excuse!
scenes.narrationZh: 回到遭遇暴風雨的晴溪村，int 搬起倒塌的木頭修屋頂，float 替農田澆水，String 用心電感應文字發出警告，而 bool 閃出紅光「FALSE！」拆穿了偷拿糧食袋的小哥布林！
scenes.dialogueEn: String (telepathic): "Kai! Someone is sneaking food sacks by the east shed!"
scenes.dialogueZh: String（心電感應）：「凱！有人在東邊棚屋偷拿糧食袋！」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: Testing the Spirits in Sunnybrook Village
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 篇章插曲：在晴溪村考驗精靈夥伴
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Climbing back into daylight, Kai and String arrived at Sunnybrook Village, where a fierce storm had battered homes, snapped fences, and washed out dry crop plots. Kai immediately called upon his crystal spirits!

The sturdy int golem reeled off twenty rapid push-ups and hoisted heavy fallen logs back into place while the clear float droplet nourished parched farm soil with bubbling water—until String suddenly stiffened, flashing an urgent telepathic alert across Kai's Spellbook: "Kai! Someone is sneaking away with the remaining food sacks near the eastern shed!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
爬回地面陽光下，凱與 String 來到了晴溪村，發現一場猛烈暴風剛摧毀了這裡的屋簷、圍欄與農田。凱立刻喚出新結交的精靈夥伴前來相助！

整數石巨人一口氣做了二十下伏地挺身，輕鬆扛起倒塌的圓木重建家園；小數水滴也湧出清澈氣泡泉水灌溉乾涸菜圃——就在此時，String 突然機警豎耳，立刻用心電感應把文字打在凱的書頁上：「凱！東邊穀倉旁有人鬼鬼祟祟地扛走了僅存的糧食袋！」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: String (telepathic): "Kai! Someone is sneaking away with the remaining food sacks near the eastern shed!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: String（心電感應）：「凱！東邊倉庫那邊有人想偷搬走剩下來的糧食袋！」

scenes.titleEn: Sharing Harvest with the Hungry Goblin
scenes.titleZh: 溫柔分享糧食給飢餓的小哥布林
scenes.narrationEn: Instead of scolding the hungry goblin, Kai knelt down and kindly shared a generous basket of the restored harvest—showing that true magic heals hearts as well as villages.
scenes.narrationZh: 凱沒有責罰飢餓的小哥布林，而是溫柔蹲下身，將大家合力救回的麵包與收成大方地分給他。真正的魔法，不只是修好村莊，更是溫暖每一顆心。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "True magic always helps those in need."
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「真正的魔法，是用來幫助需要幫助的人。」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Kai sprinted around the wooden corner and caught a sneaky little goblin stammering frantic excuses. Holding up the bool Flashing Gem, it pulsed fierce crimson and chimed "FALSE!", exposing the trick at once!

Yet seeing how thin and hungry the trembling creature looked, Kai gently lowered the gem and shared a warm portion of the restored harvest with him—teaching everyone that true wizardry blends sharp awareness, justice, and compassion for those in need.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱飛奔轉過木屋牆角，當場抓到一隻正支支吾吾編藉口的小哥布林。凱舉起測謊 bool 晶石，寶石瞬間閃出鮮紅光芒並響亮宣告「FALSE！（說謊）」，當場拆穿謊言！

但凱仔細一看，發現這隻小傢伙瘦得發抖、只是餓壞了。他收起寶石，溫柔地從恢復收成的食物裡分出一籃送給他——讓晴溪村所有人都明白，真正的魔法不只在於辨別對錯，更在於警惕、正義與幫助困苦之人的慈悲。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Flashing Gem: "FALSE!" · Kai: "No need to steal when you're hungry—come share part of the harvest with us."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 測謊寶石：「FALSE！」· 小英雄凱：「肚子餓不需要用偷的——來，這籃新鮮的食物分你一起吃吧。」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Descending beneath the library into a crystal cavern, String leaped into the str Scroll Crystal—awakening a permanent telepathic ribbon bond! Alongside the int push-up golem, float water droplet, and bool flashing gem, Kai mastered all four type() shapes.

In storm-battered Sunnybrook Village, their crystal team rebuilt cottages and restored parched crops—until String flashed a telepathic warning that caught a hungry goblin red-handed with bool FALSE!. Choosing mercy alongside truth, Kai shared a warm basket of harvest with him.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 走進地底水晶洞窟，String 躍入文字水晶 str 覺醒了心電感應對話能力！凱同時認識了愛做伏地挺身的 int 石巨人、跳動氣泡的 float 水滴，以及測謊的 bool 晶石，掌握 type() 四大形狀。
來到剛經歷暴風的晴溪村，精靈夥伴們合力重建房屋與農田；String 更及時用心電文字揪出偷食物的小哥布林。在 bool 揭露真相後，凱依然溫柔分食給飢餓的小傢伙。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 9: FORGE — Master Grimsby's Deep Dwarven Forge
storyParts.titleZh: 第九章：FORGE 運算咒 — 格里姆斯比大師的深山矮人爐
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 9: hp = 100 - 20 · Math runes (+ - * /) and Dwarven steel armor
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第九咒：hp = 100 - 20 · 踏實勞動與加減乘除戰甲魔法
storyParts.imageAltEn: Blazing forge fire and ringing anvil glowing warm amber light
storyParts.imageAltZh: 熊熊燃燒的火爐與閃爍金色光芒的鍛造鐵砧
paragraphsEn: To face the Bug King safely, Kai and String descended deep underground into the roaring Deep Dwarven Forge, ruled by fiery-bearded Master Grimsby.

Unlike the horned Blacksmith from the valley, Master Grimsby wore no helmet—his blazing ginger-orange twin-forked beard shimmered with brass rings. Before giving away any armor, Grimsby wanted to see if Kai had real grit.
Without a single complaint, Kai hauled heavy slag carts, shoveled blazing coal, and scrubbed every soot-covered brick clean, cheered on by String's glowing telepathic messages.

Won over by Kai's humble builder's heart, Master Grimsby unlocked gleaming silver Dwarven Steel Armor and a balanced Wizard's Blade! Then he taught Kai the four active combat math runes (+, -, *, /) like hp = 100 - 20 so his stats could update mid-battle.
paragraphsZh: 為了能安全迎戰蟲蟲魔王，凱和 String 深入地底，來到火花轟鳴的「深山矮人鍛造爐」，由留著火紅雙叉鬍與黃銅鬍環的格里姆斯比大師掌管。
大師想先考驗凱有沒有真正的骨氣與毅力。凱沒有一句怨言，踏實地推著沉重的礦渣車、鏟起滾燙的煤炭，還把每一塊沾滿煤灰的磚頭刷洗得乾乾淨淨，String 也傳來溫暖的心電感應文字替他加油。
格里姆斯比大師被凱真誠勤勞的態度深深打動，打開保險庫，為凱穿上閃耀的矮人鋼甲並配上一把精巧平衡的法師長劍！
接著大師傳授了四道即時戰鬥算術符文（+、-、*、/），例如 hp = 100 - 20，讓凱在面對危險時能隨時計算並調整自己的力量。

dialogue.lineEn: "You've got a true builder's heart! Wear this steel armor well, and never forget how numbers shift in battle."
dialogue.lineZh: 「你有顆真正建築者的好心腸！穿上這副矮人鋼甲，記住數字在戰鬥中是如何加減變化的！」

spell.nameZh: 第九咒：FORGE 算術魔法 — 加減乘除 (+ - * /)
spell.explainEn: Use +, -, *, and / to add, subtract, multiply, and divide numbers and update variables!
spell.explainZh: 用 +、-、*、/ 來幫數字進行加減乘除，還能把計算後的新結果存回原本的變數裡！
spell.demoOutputEn: hp updated from 100 to 80! Dwarven Steel Armor equipped! 🛡️
spell.demoOutputZh: HP 從 100 更新為 80！成功裝備矮人鋼甲！🛡️

scenes.titleEn: Master Grimsby's Challenge in the Deep Forge
scenes.titleZh: 格里姆斯比大師的考驗
scenes.narrationEn: Seeking stronger armor to protect Pythonia, Kai and String descended into the roaring Deep Dwarven Forge, where fiery-bearded Master Grimsby challenged Kai to prove his backbone!
scenes.narrationZh: 為了獲得保護王國的堅固鎧甲，凱與 String 走進轟隆作響的深山矮人鍛造爐，火紅鬍子的格里姆斯比大師立刻向凱提出毅力考驗！
scenes.dialogueEn: Master Grimsby: "Prove you've got a real builder's backbone!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 格里姆斯比大師：「證明你有真正工匠的骨氣給我看！」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 9. FORGE — The Deep Dwarven Forge (+ - * / = Change the Numbers!)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 九、FORGE 鍛造咒 — 矮人深處鍛造爐（加減乘除：+ - * /）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Realizing his worn apprentice gear wouldn't shield him from dark citadel battles ahead, Kai followed the Sunnybrook elder's map down soot-stained stone stairs into the roaring Deep Dwarven Forge, ruled by fiery-bearded Master Grimsby.

"Every kid with an apprentice cloak thinks shiny armor appears just by asking!" Grimsby grunted beside the blinding furnace. "Go haul the heavy slag, shovel blazing coal, and scrub every soot-covered brick in this cavern!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
意識到舊學徒披風不足以迎戰前方黑山的險惡，凱依循晴溪村長老的指引，沿著滿是煤灰的石階深入地底，走進烈焰咆哮的「矮人深處鍛造爐」，拜見紅鬍子大匠師格里姆斯比。

「每個披著綠斗篷的小傢伙都以為漂亮盔甲伸手求就能變出來！」格里姆斯比在火爐旁大聲哼道：「想學真本事，先去搬運沉重礦渣、剷起熾熱煤炭，把這座山洞每一塊薰黑的磚石刷洗乾淨再說！」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Master Grimsby: "Think a shiny sword drops just by asking? Haul the slag, shovel coal, and earn real steel!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 格里姆斯比大師：「以為好裝備開口就有嗎？去搬礦渣、剷煤炭，用真汗水證明你配得上矮人好鋼！」

scenes.titleEn: Grit Without Complaint & String's Telepathic Cheer
scenes.titleZh: 毫不抱怨的努力與 String 加油
scenes.narrationEn: Kai hauled heavy slag, shoveled blazing coal, and scrubbed every soot-covered brick without a single complaint—cheered on by String's glowing telepathic encouragement!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱二話不說搬運重礦渣、鏟起熾熱煤炭、刷洗焦黑石磚，一聲抱怨也沒有——而 String 也在旁不斷傳送心電感應文字替他加油！
scenes.dialogueEn: String (telepathic): "KEEP GOING KAI! ZERO COMPLAINTS!"
scenes.dialogueZh: String（心電感應）：「凱加油！你最棒了！」
scenes.spellCode: # Hard work builds a builder's heart
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
With String's warm telepathic encouragement flashing steadily inside Kai's Spellbook and mind ("Keep going, Kai, you're doing great!"), Kai hauled iron slag carts and scrubbed soot-darkened stone hour after hour without a single complaint.

Even as embers scorched the air and blisters warmed his palms, Kai worked patiently until every stone floor around the great anvil gleamed clean.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
在 String 透過心電感應不斷閃出暖心文字鼓勵之下（「加油凱，你做得好棒！」），凱一車又一車搬起沉重礦渣，一小時接著一小時細心刷洗炭磚，從頭到尾沒有半句怨言。

就算火爐熱氣蒸人、掌心微微起泡，凱依然踏踏實實地堅持到底，直到鐵砧四周的石板全都亮潔如新。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: String (telepathic): "Keep going, Kai, you're doing great! Don't give up!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: String（心電感應）：「繼續加油，凱，你做得好極了！我們一起撐過去！」

scenes.titleEn: Forging Steel Armor & Active Math: hp = 100 - 20
scenes.titleZh: 矮人鋼甲與運算魔法：hp = 100 - 20
scenes.narrationEn: Won over by Kai's true builder's heart, Master Grimsby unlocked magnificent Dwarven steel armor and a finely balanced Wizard's Blade, teaching Kai active math runes (+, -, *, /) with hp = 100 - 20!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱誠懇踏實的工匠之心打動了大師。格里姆斯比大師為他穿上閃耀的矮人鋼甲、配上平衡的法師之劍，並傳授能即時調整數值的運算符文（+ - * /）！
scenes.dialogueEn: Master Grimsby: "Wear this steel well, young builder—now cast hp = 100 - 20!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 格里姆斯比大師：「好好穿戴這套矮人鋼甲吧，年輕的造物者——試著施展 hp = 100 - 20！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Astonished by Kai's quiet grit and true builder's heart, Master Grimsby roared with laughter! He unlocked magnificent Dwarven steel armor and a finely balanced wizard's blade forged just for Kai.

As Kai buckled the shining steel plates, Grimsby etched the four living math runes (+, -, *, /) straight onto Kai's gauntlet, teaching him active combat math like hp = 100 - 20 so his Vault stats could adapt in real battle!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
格里姆斯比大師被凱這份毫無怨言的毅力與真正工匠之心深深打動，忍不住放聲大笑！他打開秘庫，親手為凱披上耀眼的矮人精鋼戰甲，並配上一柄重心完美的法師利刃。

在幫凱扣好鎧甲之際，大師把代表動態運算的四枚數學符文（+ - * /）刻上他的護手，傳授如 hp = 100 - 20 的即時數值調整咒，好讓他的寶庫數值能在實戰中靈活應變！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Master Grimsby: "You earned true steel, lad! Use + - * / like hp = 100 - 20 when battle changes the numbers!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 格里姆斯比大師：「小子，這身真鋼甲是你應得的！戰鬥中遇到數值變動時，就用 + - * / 來即時運算 hp = 100 - 20！」

scenes.titleZh: 格里姆斯比大師的溫暖送行
scenes.narrationEn: Clad in gleaming Dwarven steel armor with his Wizard's Blade ready, Kai saluted Master Grimsby warmly and ascended with String toward the mist-shrouded highlands.
scenes.narrationZh: 身穿堅固的矮人鋼甲與法師之劍，凱向格里姆斯比大師敬禮道別，與 String 一起沿著石階走向雲霧繚繞的高地。
scenes.dialogueEn: Master Grimsby: "Don't go getting broken out there, kid!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 格里姆斯比大師：「小子，在外面別把自己弄壞了啊！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
After a fond farewell from roaring Master Grimsby at the forge doorway, Kai and String climbed back out beneath high twilight skies clad in gleaming Dwarven steel.

With boots striking crisp sparks off highland slate and balanced blade slung proudly alongside his glowing Spellbook, hero and pup set off toward the mist-shrouded mountain valleys ahead.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
在格里姆斯比大師欣慰又洪亮的祝福道別聲中，身穿閃耀鋼甲的凱帶著 String 再次走出地底鍛造爐。

鋼靴踩在高地石板上發出沉穩清脆的聲響，細膩平衡的新寶劍與《古老咒語書》並掛身旁——一人一狗昂首邁向霧氣瀰漫的高山峽谷。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Master Grimsby: "Walk tall, little builder!" · Kai: "Thank you for everything, Master Grimsby!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 格里姆斯比大師：「抬頭挺胸向前走吧，小工匠！」· 小英雄凱：「謝謝您教會我的一切，格里姆斯比大師！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Hauling heavy iron slag and scrubbing soot-stained bricks inside the Deep Dwarven Forge with String cheering in his mind, Kai proved his quiet grit without a single complaint.

Delighted, Master Grimsby rewarded Kai with gleaming Dwarven steel armor, a balanced blade, and the active math runes (+, -, *, /) like hp = 100 - 20 before waving both companions into the misty valleys above.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 在格里姆斯比大師的地底鍛造爐裡，凱頂著高溫搬運礦渣、鏟煤刷磚毫無怨言，耳畔滿是 String 的心電打氣。
這份沉穩踏實贏得大師大笑讚賞，賜予凱矮人精鋼鎧甲、利刃與加減乘除即時運算咒語（+ - * /，例如 hp = 100 - 20），助他整裝迎向雲霧山巒。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 10: SIGHT — Twin Illusion Paths & Eye of Truth
storyParts.titleZh: 第十章：SIGHT 真視咒 — 真理雙歧幻路與真理之眼
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 10: print(100 > 0) · Compare facts and shatter illusions
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第十咒：print(100 > 0) · 比較真偽、識破虛假幻象
storyParts.imageAltEn: Armored Hero Kai facing the shadowed Bug King across glowing comparison runes
storyParts.imageAltZh: 穿上裝備的小英雄凱在發光符文前直面蟲蟲魔王的幻象考驗
paragraphsEn: After saying a warm goodbye to Master Grimsby, Kai and String hiked across high misty cliffs until the road split into two identical dirt paths beneath a giant stone arch: the Eye of Truth.
One path was real, and one was a dangerous mirage! Summoning the SIGHT spell, Kai's eyes flared with bright light and his eyebrows sharpened into glowing parallel lines (==).
Through his SIGHT eyes, Kai saw the hidden code underneath the cliffs! One road flickered with unstable glitching wires, while the other shone with steady, solid logic.
Kai stepped forward and cast print(100 > 0). "TRUE!" boomed the Eye of Truth! The fake mirage path shattered like glass into sparkling mist, leaving only the real road open toward the summit.
paragraphsZh: 向格里姆斯比大師道別後，凱與 String 爬上高聳霧氣瀰漫的懸崖，道路在巨大的石拱門「真理之眼」下方分成兩條看起來一模一樣的小徑。
其中一條是真路，另一條則是危險的幻象陷阱！凱發動了「真視咒」，雙眼閃耀光芒，眉毛化為兩道發亮的平行線（==）。
透過真視之眼，凱看見了山崖底下隱藏的程式碼結構！左邊的假路閃爍著混亂破碎的雜訊線條，右邊的真路則流淌著穩定清晰的邏輯光脈。
凱向前一步唸出：print(100 > 0)。「TRUE！」真理之眼發出洪鐘般的迴響，假冒的幻象道路像玻璃一樣碎裂消散，只留下通往山頂的真實道路！

dialogue.lineEn: "TRUE! Only clear sight that checks the facts can shatter an illusion."
dialogue.lineZh: 「TRUE！唯有仔細核對事實的清晰雙眼，才能擊碎虛假的幻象。」

spell.nameZh: 第十咒：SIGHT 比較魔法 — 大於小於與等於 (> < ==)
spell.explainEn: Use > (greater than), < (less than), and == (is equal to?) to check if something is True or False!
spell.explainZh: 用 >（大於）、<（小於）和兩個等號 ==（是否相等？）來比較事實，魔法會回答 True 或 False！
spell.demoOutputEn: True!  ✨ (Mirage shattered! The true path to the summit shines clearly!)
spell.demoOutputZh: True!  ✨（幻象碎裂！通往山頂的真實道路閃亮開啟！）

scenes.titleEn: The Highland Fork Beneath the Eye of Truth
scenes.titleZh: 真理之眼下的雙歧幻路
scenes.narrationEn: Crossing mist-shrouded valleys, Kai and String reached a cliffside fork where two completely identical dirt paths split beneath the giant stone Eye of Truth.
scenes.narrationZh: 穿過薄霧山谷後，凱與 String 來到崎嶇高地，眼前出現兩條一模一樣的泥土小路，頭頂則矗立著巨大的「真理之眼」石拱門。
scenes.dialogueEn: Eye of Truth: "Only truth can shatter illusion."
scenes.dialogueZh: 真理之眼：「唯有真實，才能擊碎虛幻。」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 10. SIGHT — The Twin Illusion Paths (> < == = Compare & Find the Truth!)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 十、SIGHT 真視咒 — 雙生幻影岔路（比較真理：> < ==）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Hiking far above the valley ridges, Kai and String entered a quiet highland gorge wrapped in swirling purple fog.

Right before them, the mountain road split into two completely identical dirt paths disappearing into thick mist—while towering above the fork hovered the giant, unblinking stone Eye of Truth.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
翻過重重幽谷，凱和 String 步入了一條籠罩在濃郁紫色霧氣中的寂靜高原峽谷。

眼前道路突然分岔成兩條無論泥土顏色、草木甚至石塊位置都一模一樣的詭異小徑；而在岔路正上方，正懸浮著一顆巨大而沉靜的「真理之眼」。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Both dirt roads look completely identical in this purple mist... which one is a trap?"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「兩條路在這片紫霧裡看起來完全一模一樣……哪一條才是暗藏危機的幻象陷阱呢？」

scenes.titleZh: 覺醒真視之眼與 == 平行雙眉
scenes.narrationEn: Summoning the SIGHT spell, Kai's eyes flared with radiant light and his eyebrows sharpened into glowing parallel lines (==)—instantly exposing the fake path's unstable glitching code!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱召喚真視咒語——他的雙眼閃耀璀璨光芒，眉毛化為兩道發光的平行線（==）！瞬間看穿整片大地的底層程式碼，假路上的錯亂幻影無所遁形！
scenes.dialogueEn: String (telepathic): "THE LEFT PATH IS GLITCHING!"
scenes.dialogueZh: String（心電感應）：「左邊那條路的程式在閃爍出錯！」
scenes.spellCode: # Sight Eyes (==) reveal true vs. fake code
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Ordinary eyes couldn't tell real stone from dark illusion—so Kai summoned the tenth Ancient Spell: SIGHT!

Instantly, Kai's eyes flared with luminous radiant light and his eyebrows sharpened into twin glowing parallel lines (==), lifting the veil of ordinary vision to expose the fake path's unstable, glitching broken code alongside the true path's clean, honest logic.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
肉眼無法穿透邪惡法術編織的假象，於是凱集中精神，發動第十道古老善咒——SIGHT 真視之瞳！

霎時之間，凱的雙眸綻放璀璨星輝，雙眉化作兩條筆直發光的平行線（==）！在真視之瞳下，表象的霧紗瞬間褪去，揭露出左方假路下方其實是扭曲亂碼與破損幻影，唯有右邊真路散發出穩定清澈的邏輯光輝。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Now I see beneath the mist—one trail flickers with broken glitches while the other shines solid and true!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「我看穿霧氣底層了——左邊這條閃滿破碎亂碼，右邊這條才閃耀著真實穩固的邏輯光芒！」

scenes.titleZh: 施展比較魔法：print(100 > 0)
scenes.narrationEn: Looking steadily through the illusions, Kai raised his Wizard's Blade and cast: print(100 > 0) straight toward the towering Eye of Truth!
scenes.narrationZh: 看穿一切虛假後，凱堅定舉起法師之劍，朝真理之眼施展比較咒語：print(100 > 0)！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "print(100 > 0)! True!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「print(100 > 0)！結果是 True！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn: Raising his balanced wizard's wand toward the hovering stone archway, Kai aimed his sharpened == SIGHT directly at the numbers floating above the fork and cast his formal comparison test: print(100 > 0).
scenes.advanceNarrationZh: 凱舉起矮人鍛造的新魔杖指向高懸的真理石門，讓閃耀着 == 雙線光芒的眼神鎖定岔路上的數值，朗聲吟唱比較咒語：print(100 > 0)！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Let the truth speak! print(100 > 0)!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「讓真實顯現吧！print(100 > 0)！」

scenes.titleZh: 真理之眼回響 TRUE！擊碎幻影道路
scenes.narrationEn: "TRUE!" boomed the Eye of Truth, shattering the fake path into glittering glass shards and leaving only the true road open straight to the summit!
scenes.narrationZh: 「TRUE！」真理之眼發出洪亮回響，假的道路瞬間像玻璃一樣碎裂消散，只留下通往山頂的真實大道！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "One more step to the summit—let's go, String!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「就快到山頂了——我們走吧，String！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
"TRUE!" boomed the giant Eye of Truth across the gorge.

In a dazzling cascade of silver sound, the fake mirage path shattered into shimmering purple glass dust—leaving only the true sunlit trail clean and wide open up toward the windswept summit!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
「TRUE！（真實成立！）」真理之眼發出震動整座山谷的宏亮宣告。

伴隨清脆的崩裂聲，左邊整條偽裝岔路如紫水晶玻璃般碎成點點微光消散在空氣裡——只留下那條真正通往高山之巔的坦途！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Eye of Truth: "TRUE!" · Kai: "The mirage shattered, String! Let's climb to the summit!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 真理之眼：「TRUE！」· 小英雄凱：「幻影碎掉了，String！我們一口氣登上山頂吧！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Blocked in purple mist by two completely identical dirt roads beneath the giant Eye of Truth, Kai awakened SIGHT—turning his eyes bright and his eyebrows into glowing parallel bars (==) to spot glitching mirage code beneath the trap.
Casting print(100 > 0) drew a booming "TRUE!" that shattered the fake path into glass and cleared the true summit trail ahead.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 在真理之眼下的紫色濃霧岔路前，兩條路看起來毫無差別；凱及時喚醒真視之瞳 SIGHT，讓雙眉化作閃亮平行線（==）看破底下跳動的假亂碼。
一聲 print(100 > 0) 換來「TRUE！」的莊嚴裁決，假幻象應聲如玻璃般碎裂，指明了真正通往山頂的大道。

storyParts.titleEn: Chapter 11: FATE — The Final Crossroads & Golden Colon Gates
storyParts.titleZh: 第十一章：FATE 命運咒 — 最後的十字路口與金色冒號
storyParts.subtitleEn: Spell 11: if / elif / else : · Choose your path with 4-space steps
storyParts.subtitleZh: 第十一咒：if / elif / else : · 用金色冒號與四格縮排開啟命運之門
storyParts.imageAltEn: Hero Kai standing ready before the towering Citadel crossroads beneath dramatic storm light
storyParts.imageAltZh: 在最後的十字路口前，小英雄凱準備運用命運分歧咒打開通往堡壘的石門
paragraphsEn: At the windswept summit plateau, Kai and String reached a three-way crossroads sealed by a huge middle stone barrier. Three wooden signposts pointed different ways: DRAGON, TREASURE, and HOME.
A hooded Signpost-Keeper tapped his staff against the stones: "You cannot walk all three paths at once. Let your choice depend on what your SIGHT proves TRUE!"

Kai opened his Spellbook for the eleventh and final Ancient Spell: FATE! He placed a golden Colon (:) at the end of each condition gate, and carefully stepped four spaces forward inside every branch so Pythonia knew which action belonged inside which gate.

if hp > 50: print("Open the Citadel Gate!") ... CRACK! Because Kai's HP was over 50, the first golden gate blazed open! The eleventh Crest locked onto Kai's belt, and the giant middle stone barrier dissolved.
paragraphsZh: 登上狂風吹拂的山頂平台，凱和 String 來到三岔路口，正前方被一塊巨大的中央石牆擋住，旁邊立著三座木頭路標：巨龍（DRAGON）、寶藏（TREASURE）、回家（HOME）。
戴著兜帽的路標守衛敲響手杖：「你不能同時走三條路！讓你的選擇取決於真視之眼驗證出來的『真（TRUE）』吧！」
凱翻開咒語書最後一頁——第十一道古老魔法「FATE 命運咒」！他在每個條件門口放上閃耀的金色冒號「:」，並且在每扇門後整齊地向前踏出「四個空白步（縮排）」，告訴魔法每一條路該做什麼事。
if hp > 50: 接著縮排執行 print("Open the Citadel Gate!") ……轟隆一聲！因為凱的 HP 大於 50，第一扇大門耀眼開啟！第十一枚徽章扣上腰帶，擋路的巨石應聲消散。

dialogue.lineEn: "You cannot walk all three—let your choice depend on what your SIGHT proves TRUE!"
dialogue.lineZh: 「你不能同時走三條路——讓真視所證明的『真實』為你決定方向吧！」

spell.nameZh: 第十一咒：FATE 命運分歧魔法 — if / elif / else :
spell.explainEn: if / elif / else checks conditions in order! Never forget the golden colon : and the 4-space step inside.
spell.explainZh: if / elif / else 會依序檢查哪個條件是真的！千萬別忘了門口的金色冒號 : 和裡面的四格縮排喔！
spell.demoOutputEn: CRACK! hp (80) > 50 is True -> Output: Open the Citadel Gate!
spell.demoOutputZh: 轟隆！hp (80) > 50 為真 -> 執行結果：Open the Citadel Gate!

scenes.titleZh: 山頂十字路口與中央巨石屏障
scenes.narrationEn: At the windswept summit plateau, Kai and String faced a three-way crossroads sealed by a massive middle stone barrier and three wooden signposts: DRAGON, TREASURE, and HOME.
scenes.narrationZh: 登上狂風吹拂的山頂高原，三條岔路與「巨龍（DRAGON）」、「寶藏（TREASURE）」、「回家（HOME）」三座木頭路標前，矗立著一道巨大的石門屏障。
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "We can only walk one path—which gate opens the Citadel?"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「只能選一條路……哪一道門能通往核心聖殿？」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: 11. FATE — The Final Crossroads (if / elif / else + : + 4 steps)
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 十一、FATE 命運咒 — 最終十字路口（分支抉擇：if / elif / else）
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Climbing onto the windswept summit plateau beneath churning violet storm clouds, Kai and String stood before a grand three-way crossroads.

Three weathered wooden signposts pointed outward—DRAGON, TREASURE, and HOME—while an immense middle stone barrier sealed the royal archway rising toward the Bug King's Citadel of Core.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
登上狂風呼嘯的高山平臺，在翻湧的深紫雷雲之下，凱和 String 來到了整場冒險的最後關頭——三岔命運十字路口。

三塊古木路牌各自指向三個截然不同的方向：「DRAGON 巨龍」、「TREASURE 寶藏」與「HOME 回家」；而通往正中央蟲蟲魔王核芯城堡的宏偉大道，則被一面巨大無比的石門緊緊封住。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Three signposts—DRAGON, TREASURE, and HOME—and a massive middle stone barrier blocking the Citadel!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「三根路標——巨龍、寶藏與回家——還有這道擋在城堡正前方的巨型石門！」

scenes.titleZh: 兜帽守路人的指引
scenes.narrationEn: The hooded Signpost-Keeper tapped his staff against the stone paving: "You cannot walk all three—let your choice depend on what your SIGHT proves TRUE!"
scenes.narrationZh: 披著兜帽的守路人輕敲手中的銅燈手杖：「你不能同時走三條路——讓你的真視之眼所驗證的真實，來決定命運的去向！」
scenes.dialogueEn: Signpost-Keeper: "Let your choice depend on what SIGHT proves TRUE!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 守路人：「讓真視所證明的真理，引領你的選擇！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Beside the stone threshold stood the hooded Signpost-Keeper, leaning calmly on a gnarled staff while lightning flickered high overhead.

"You cannot walk all three paths at once," the Keeper decreed above the wind. "Let your choice depend upon what your SIGHT proves TRUE!"
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
路口石柱旁站著一位披著兜帽的「路標守護者」，他在高空電光閃爍中安靜地拄著老樹魔杖。

「你不可能同時走上三條路，旅人。」守護者在狂風中莊嚴宣示：「讓你的命運抉擇，完全取決於你的『真視之瞳 SIGHT』所驗證出的結果是否為真（TRUE）！」
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Signpost-Keeper: "You cannot walk all three—let your choice depend on what your SIGHT proves TRUE!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 路標守護者：「你無法同時走完三條路——讓你的真視咒驗證出哪一條才是真正該走的道路吧！」

scenes.titleEn: Opening if / elif / else with Golden Colons & 4 Steps
scenes.titleZh: 金色冒號 (:) 與四格縮排步伐
scenes.narrationEn: Kai opened each gate with a golden Colon : and stepped four careful spaces forward behind every gate: if hp > 50: print("Open the Citadel Gate!") elif gold < 10: ... else: ...
scenes.narrationZh: 凱用閃耀的金色冒號（:）打開每一道門，並在門後穩穩向前踏出四步縮排步伐：if hp > 50: print("Open the Citadel Gate!") ……
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "if hp > 50: ... four steps in! Open the Citadel Gate!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「if hp > 50: ……向右踏出四步縮排！開啟城堡大門！」
scenes.spellCode: Spell: if hp > 50: (4 spaces) print("Open the Citadel Gate!")
scenes.spellLabelZh: 第十一咒：FATE 命運魔法 (if / elif / else :)
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Golden Colon : on every gate, and four steady steps forward inside each block!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「每道大門加上金色冒號 : ，再為裡頭的每個行動整齊踏出四步縮排！」

scenes.titleZh: 第十一道徽章歸位與石門開啟
scenes.narrationEn: CRACK! The first gate blazed open, locking the eleventh Ancient Crest onto Kai's belt! The massive stone barrier dissolved into golden dust, opening the way to the Citadel of Core.
scenes.narrationZh: 轟隆！第一道命運之門瞬間亮起，第十一枚古老徽章卡入凱的腰帶！中央巨石屏障化作漫天金粉消散，通往「核心聖殿」的大門敞開了！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "All Eleven Crests—the Citadel is open!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「十一枚徽章都齊全了——核心聖殿開啟了！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
CRACK! Because Kai's Dwarven-forged hp stood well above 50, the very first Citadel gate blazed open with blinding golden light—locking the eleventh and final Ancient Crest proudly onto his belt!

At that moment, the immense middle stone barrier dissolved into drifting emerald stardust, revealing the towering gateway of the Citadel of Core straight ahead.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
「轟隆——啪！」由於凱的生命值 hp 充沛且大於 50，第一道分支大門頓時綻放耀眼金光應聲敞開——第十一枚、也是最後一枚古老善咒徽章正式鎖上凱的腰帶！

與此同時，阻擋在路中央的巨大石牆化作漫天飛舞的翠綠星塵緩緩消散，露出了直通魔王「核芯城堡」的巍峨大門。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "The eleventh crest locked into place! Look, String—the Citadel of Core awaits us inside!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「第十一枚徽章成功歸位了！String，核芯城堡的大門已經為我們敞開！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Facing the windswept summit crossroads labeled DRAGON, TREASURE, and HOME alongside the hooded Signpost-Keeper, Kai opened each branching gate with a golden Colon : and stepped four measured paces inside each gate.
With his if hp > 50 / elif gold < 10 / else spell blazing true, CRACK! The eleventh Ancient Crest locked onto his belt and the massive stone Citadel barrier dissolved into stardust.
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 在山頂狂風中的最終三岔路口，面對巨龍、寶藏與回家的路標和路標守護者的考驗，凱以金色冒號 : 與精準的四步縮排刻下 if / elif / else 的智慧抉擇。
伴隨「喀啦」一聲巨響，第十一枚古老善咒徽章正式歸位，擋在核芯城堡大門前的巨型石壁隨之化作星塵打開！

storyParts.titleEn: Epilogue: The Clash of Fates & Birth of the True Guardian
storyParts.titleZh: 終章：命運決戰與真正守護精靈的誕生
storyParts.subtitleEn: All 11 Spells United · Shattering darkness to free Pythonia's gentle dawn
storyParts.subtitleZh: 十一善咒合而為一 · 擊碎黑暗外殼，迎接蟒蛇王國的黎明
storyParts.imageAltEn: Hero Kai resting joyfully in a sunlit wildflower meadow under clear skies after restoring peace to Pythonia
storyParts.imageAltZh: 在奪回和平後的晨光花海草地上，小英雄凱安心微笑仰望晴朗藍天
paragraphsEn: As the grand gateway to the Citadel of Core swung wide, the earth split open! Rising in jagged obsidian armor, the Bug King pulled Kai and String down into his subterranean throne room.

For hours, Kai and String fought side by side with calm courage. Kai's Dwarven Steel Armor held firm against heavy scythe blows, while String darted like golden lightning, flashing telepathic str callouts straight to Kai's Spellbook!

Weaving # mutes, type() checks, hp = hp - 15 math, > comparisons, and if / elif / else tactics, Kai lit up his glowing == SIGHT eyes—spotting the exact tangled flaw in the Bug King's dark shell and shattering it with a burst of golden light!

As the smoke cleared, the broken obsidian shell split open—Tap. Tap. Crack.—and out wobbled a tiny, adorable Baby Praying Mantis with bright emerald-green eyes! Freed from the dark prison that twisted his magic, the true Spell Guardian thanked Kai, and together—Kai, String, and their tiny new friend—watched the warm sunrise of a peaceful Pythonia.
paragraphsZh: 核心堡壘的大門敞開之際，大地突然裂開！身披鋸齒黑曜石鎧甲的蟲蟲魔王從地底升起，將凱與 String 拉進地底王座大廳。
凱與 String 並肩奮戰了許久。凱的矮人鋼甲穩穩擋下揮擊，String 如金色閃電般靈巧穿梭，透過心電感應絲帶把對手的動向即時傳進凱的咒語書裡！
凱融合全部十一道善咒的力量——運用 # 靜音掩護、type() 觀察、hp = hp - 15 計算與 if/else 戰術，並點亮 == 真視之眼，精準看穿黑曜石鎧甲上混亂程式碼的破綻，一舉擊碎了黑暗外殼！
煙霧散去，裂開的黑殼裡傳來輕輕的聲響——喀、喀、啪！——一隻有著明亮翠綠大眼睛的可愛小螳螂搖搖晃晃走了出來！原來牠就是被黑暗困住、真正的「咒語守護神」。太陽緩緩升起，凱、String 與小小的守護神並肩望著重獲平靜與生機的蟒蛇王國。

dialogue.lineZh: 「你們的冒險就在這裡結束吧！」

dialogue.lineEn: "Thank you, young traveler. I am the true Spell Guardian of Pythonia. Because of your courage and kindness, balance has finally been restored."
dialogue.lineZh: 「謝謝你，年輕的旅人。我才是蟒蛇王國真正的咒語守護神。因為你的勇氣與善良，這片土地終於恢復了平衡。」

spell.nameEn: The Grand Weave: All 11 Spells United
spell.nameZh: 終極合奏：十一道善咒合一
spell.explainEn: Every Python spell works together when guided by patience, honesty, and care for others and the Earth!
spell.explainZh: 當我們用耐心、誠實與關懷來編寫魔法，十一道程式咒語就能合為一體，讓世界變得更美好！
spell.demoBtnZh: 喚醒黎明小螳螂守護神 🌱
spell.demoOutputEn: Tap. Tap. Crack. 🌱 Dawn restored to Pythonia! Thank you, Spellkeeper!
spell.demoOutputZh: 喀、喀、啪！🌱 蟒蛇王國重現曙光！謝謝你，小小守咒人！

scenes.titleEn: Summoned into the Bug King's Throne Room
scenes.titleZh: 墜入地底王座與蟲蟲魔王現身
scenes.narrationEn: Suddenly, the earth split open! The Bug King himself rose in jagged obsidian armor, pulling Kai and String down into his subterranean throne room.
scenes.narrationZh: 突然大地裂開！身穿鋸齒黑曜石鎧甲的蟲蟲魔王從深淵現身，將凱與 String 拉進地底王座大廳！
scenes.dialogueEn: Bug King: "Your journey ends here, little coder!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 蟲蟲魔王：「你的旅程到此為止了，小程式員！」
scenes.advanceSectionEn: Epilogue: The Clash of Fates & Birth of the True Guardian
scenes.advanceSectionZh: 終章：命運之戰與真實守護者的誕生
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
The instant the middle barrier dissolved and the grand gateway to the Citadel of Core swung wide, the mountain earth split open beneath Kai's boots!

Rising from the abyss in towering jagged obsidian armor, the Bug King himself pulled Kai and String down into his vast subterranean throne room—lit by crackling green lightning and swirling storms of broken code.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
就在石牆融化、核芯城堡大門敞開的那一剎那，腳下的山岩突然猛烈裂開！

身披尖銳黑曜石重甲的蟲蟲魔王親自從深淵升起，一舉將凱與 String 捲入地底深處的宏偉王座大廳——四周電光如翠蛇亂竄，無數破損程式碼如風暴般狂舞。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Bug King: "So the gentle coder with the empty book finally stands before my throne!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 蟲蟲魔王：「帶著空白古書來到這裡的溫柔編碼者啊……你終於踏進我的王座大廳了！」

scenes.titleZh: 矮人鋼甲與 String 的閃電夾擊
scenes.narrationEn: For hours, Kai and String fought bravely! Kai's Dwarven steel armor held firm against fierce scythe blows while String darted like golden lightning via telepathic str commands!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱與 String 並肩奮戰！矮人鋼甲穩穩擋下猛烈的鐮刀攻勢，String 化作一道金色閃電繞到側翼，透過心電感應文字傳遞戰術！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "String, flank left! Let's weave our spells!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「String，從左翼包抄！把十一道咒語織在一起！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
For hours across the echoing chamber, Kai and String fought courageously side by side!

Master Grimsby's Dwarven steel armor held firm against sweeping obsidian scythe blows, while String streaked across the stone floor like golden lightning—dodging chaos and flanking effortlessly via instant telepathic str commands flashed straight between pup and hero.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
在地底王座大廳裡，凱與 String 並肩奮戰了整整數個小時！

格里姆斯比大師親手鍛造的矮人鋼甲一次次擋下黑曜巨鐮的猛擊，而忠誠的 String 則宛如一道閃耀金雷般在黑影之間穿梭迂迴——靠著只屬於一人一狗的心電感應 str 文字指令，展開天衣無縫的左右夾擊！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: String (telepathic): "Left flank is open, Kai! Hold your armor steady—I've got your back!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: String（心電感應）：「凱，左側露出破綻了！穩住鋼盾——我在你身後掩護你！」

scenes.titleEn: Piercing the Core Vulnerability with == SIGHT
scenes.titleZh: 真視雙眼看穿弱點、擊碎黑暗外殼
scenes.narrationEn: Activating his glowing == SIGHT eyes, Kai spotted the exact vulnerability in the Bug King's core logic—and delivered one precision strike to shatter the dark corrupted shell!
scenes.narrationZh: 凱啟動發光的 == 真視雙眼，精準看見蟲蟲魔王核心邏輯的破綻——他揮出溫柔而堅定的一擊，將扭曲黑暗的黑曜石外殼徹底擊碎！
scenes.dialogueEn: Kai: "I see the flaw—== SIGHT! Let the shadows fall away!"
scenes.dialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「我看見破綻了——== 真視之眼！讓陰影消散吧！」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
Drawing on all eleven spells of kindness together, Kai kept calm—weaving silent # notes to track patterns, type() inspections to decode shifting illusions, hp = hp - 15 adjustments to guard his health, > checks to gauge force, and swift if / elif / else tactics.

At last, igniting his glowing == SIGHT eyes through the static storm, Kai spotted the exact hidden flaw inside the Bug King's core logic and struck true—shattering the dark obsidian shell in one golden burst!
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
凱喚齊十一道善咒的全部智慧與平靜之心——用 # 靜音筆跡理清戰況、以 type() 識破偽裝、靠 hp = hp - 15 精準調整防禦，並以 > 與 if / elif / else 靈活應對每一招變化。

終於，凱點亮雙眉間閃耀星芒的 == 真視之瞳，看穿了蟲蟲魔王核心程式碼中最隱密的一處漏洞，集中所有勇氣與善念迎面一擊——震碎了那層冰冷的黑曜硬殼！
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Kai: "Every spell from calm kindness together—NOW, == SIGHT! Right through the glitch!"
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 小英雄凱：「匯集每一道善念與智慧——看清真相吧，== 真視之瞳！貫穿錯亂的核心！」

scenes.titleEn: Birth of the Baby Praying Mantis Spell Guardian
scenes.titleZh: 小螳螂咒語守護神破殼誕生
scenes.narrationEn: Tap. Tap. Crack. Out from the broken black shell wobbled a tiny, adorable baby praying mantis with bright emerald eyes—the true Spell Guardian of Pythonia! Together, Kai, String, and their new companion looked out at a bright new dawn.
scenes.narrationZh: 叩、叩、喀嚓。從破裂的黑殼裡，搖搖晃晃走出一隻有著明亮翠綠大眼睛的可愛小螳螂——原來牠才是蟒蛇王國真正的「咒語守護神」！凱、String 與新夥伴一起望向嶄新和平的黎明。
scenes.dialogueEn: Spell Guardian: "Because of your courage, balance has been restored."
scenes.dialogueZh: 小螳螂守護神：「多虧了你的勇氣，王國終於恢復了和諧與平衡。」
scenes.advanceNarrationEn:
As the static smoke cleared, the cracked black obsidian shell shook gently. Tap. Tap. Crack! Splitting cleanly open, out wobbled not a monster at all—but a tiny, adorable baby praying mantis with bright emerald-green eyes, glistening wing-buds, and curious antennae!

"Thank you, young traveler," a gentle voice echoed straight into Kai's mind. "For ages, the dark monarch imprisoned me inside my own shell, twisting my magic into corruption. I am the true Spell Guardian of Pythonia. Because of your courage, balance has finally been restored to the realm."

Standing together—Kai, String, and their tiny green companion—they gazed out toward the warm dawn of a brand-new era for Pythonia.
scenes.advanceNarrationZh:
當雜訊煙霧散盡，地上裂開的黑曜石甲殼輕輕晃動起來。「叩、叩、喀啦！」外殼從中裂開——走出來的不僅不是猙獰怪物，而是一隻模樣可愛極了的翠綠小螳螂寶寶，有著清澈明亮的綠寶石大眼、泛著珍珠微光的小翅芽和好奇擺動的觸角！

「謝謝你，溫柔的旅人。」一個溫暖澄淨的聲音直接傳進凱的心底：「長久以來，黑暗執念把我囚禁在自己的外殼裡，把我的力量扭曲成了災厄。我才是蟒蛇王國真正的『魔法守護者』。因為你的勇敢與善良，整個王國終於恢復了和諧與平衡。」

並肩站在一起——小英雄凱、忠犬 String，還有他們小小的綠寶石新夥伴——一同望向灑滿清晨金色曙光的嶄新蟒蛇王國。
scenes.advanceDialogueEn: Spell Guardian: "I am the true Spell Guardian of Pythonia. Because of your courage, balance has finally been restored."
scenes.advanceDialogueZh: 魔法守護者：「我才是蟒蛇王國真正的魔法守護者。因為你的勇氣與善良，世界終於重歸和諧！」

paragraphsAdvanceEn: Dragged down by jagged obsidian armor into the Bug King's lightning-lit throne room, Kai and String fought bravely for hours—Dwarven steel blocking scythe blows while String flanked like golden lightning via telepathic str signals.

Weaving all eleven spells together and piercing the dark core's glitch with blazing == SIGHT eyes, Kai shattered the obsidian armor (Tap. Tap. Crack.)—freeing a tiny emerald-eyed baby praying mantis: Pythonia's true Spell Guardian, who hailed balance restored to the dawn!
paragraphsAdvanceZh: 大門開啟的瞬間地裂天搖，凱與 String 被蟲蟲魔王捲入地底雷電王座大廳。一人一狗並肩奮戰數小時——矮人鋼甲迎戰巨鐮，String 如金電般配合心電文字流穿梭夾擊。
最後凱結合十一道善咒並以 == 真視之瞳看穿魔王核心破綻，一舉震碎黑曜石殼！「叩、叩、喀啦」——裡頭破殼而出的竟是可愛的翠綠小螳螂寶寶、真正的蟒蛇王國魔法守護者，在溫暖晨曦中宣告和平與平衡重回大地！
